fields.body_html:
Chapter 1
"Why, Madison? Why did you have to do this to me?

"Did I not treat you well in our five years of marriage? Why did you have to go sleep with another man behind my back?" Cameron Morgan asked angrily.

A beautiful woman in black office wear sat before him in the villa.

On the table between them were several photos of her being intimate with another man as they walked into a hotel.

"Did you stalk me, Cameron?" Madison Parker furrowed her brow as she stared at the photos on the table.

There was not an ounce of regret on her face, just coldness. "If that's the case, then let's just divorce."

"Divorce?" A low buzz sounded in Cameron's mind upon hearing that. He suddenly felt like he might collapse.

He had only wanted Madison to give him an explanation for her actions and tell him it wasn't what he thought it was, even if that may be a lie.

Yet what Madison gave him was a suggestion of divorce.

"Yes, divorce. Here's the papers. You can sign right here." Madison pulled out a set of papers from her Hermes bag worth hundreds of thousands of dollars and set it in front of Cameron.

Cameron stared at the papers in disbelief before turning to Madison. "Have you wanted to divorce me from the start?"

"You forced me to. I hate it when people stalk me," Madison said coldly.

"So it's still all my fault in the end?"

"Don't look at me like that, Cameron. You've been depending on me for all these years. You have no right to concern yourself with who I'm with."

"No right to concern myself? You're my wife, Madison! My lawfully wedded wife!" Cameron wanted to yell, yet all his strength disappeared the instant he looked at the divorce papers.

Cameron clenched his hands into fists, his nails digging into his palm.

"So what?" Madison was nonchalant about it. "If you don't want to, then divorce me. But let me set the bar straight first–since you can't accept my behavior post-marriage, you have to leave empty handed."

Cameron's eyes widened as he stared at Madison in shock. He had never imagined she would say things like this before this incident.

Was Madison still the kind young girl Cameron met fifteen years ago? The girl who gave him food and words of encouragement when he was at his lowest?

"Alright, enough wasting my time. Hurry up and sign the divorce papers," Madison's cold tone interrupted Cameron's train of thought.

Cameron turned back to Madison, this cold-blooded and selfish woman.

Women change in adulthood, sure. Madison's appearance had changed, but did her personality change so greatly too?

Cameron could no longer see the glow of hope and kindness in Madison's eyes from all those years ago.

He grew disappointed. "I realized you really have changed, Madison. Sometimes I wonder if you're still the girl from all those years ago."

"What are you trying to say, Cameron? I advise you to not talk about these useless matters if you're only trying to drag time out," Madison said coldly.

What girl from years ago? She had never met Cameron prior to their marriage.

Cameron didn't answer. He only asked as a final confirmation, "Do you really want to divorce me, Madison?"

"Yes," she said steadfastly.

"I understand." Cameron sighed. His gaze darkened.

Madison was taken aback by the sudden change. Cameron seemed to have become an entirely different person in that split second.

But when Madison looked again, Cameron was still the same Cameron – the meek little man who cooked and kept house for her.

Her tone was already filled with disdain. "You should've known we're not from the same world from the start."

"Yeah." Cameron didn't retort this time. "You're a powerful CEO who's on Yrando's list of top ten outstanding businessmen. I'm nothing but a dishwasher and personal chef, someone you think is utterly useless."

Madison was surprised by how clearly Cameron was seeing things right now.

A vain smile appeared on her face. "Looks like you've finally understood how useless and incompatible you are with me."

"Haha, is that so?" Cameron smiled sarcastically. "To be honest, I have to thank you for showing me your true colors today."

"What do you mean?" Madison frowned.

"What do I mean? Five years... Five whole years... When have I not warmed up dinner for you when you came home late? I massaged your feet when you're tired and spent entire nights taking care of you when you got period pains.

"You said you wanted to start your own business, so I gave you my assets to support your endeavor. Five years... Even a dog would have had some affection after so many years..."

"That's enough from you, Cameron!" Madison snapped, interrupting his words.

She reacted like a cat that had had its tail stepped on. Her face was red with anger.

"I never asked you to do any of that! You did all of that of your own volition! And my company only made it to where it is today because of my hard work and effort. All these years of living off of my resources is enough repayment for the money you gave me!"

"Is that so?" Cameron gazed at Madison like she was a stranger. "Do you really think your success today is credited to you alone?"

"Isn't it?" Madison retorted.

Cameron didn't respond.

He swiftly signed his name on the divorce papers, no longer seeing any hope in this relationship.

Cameron set the pen down and tossed the papers in front of Madison. He said coldly, "I hope you don't regret this divorce in the future."

Cameron then turned around.

"What's with the attitude, Cameron? Stop and explain yourself!" Madison roared angrily.

But Cameron never gave her a second glance as he walked out of the villa.

There was nothing worth cherishing in this place anymore.

…

Ding!

Cameron's phone rang the moment he stepped out the gate.

In the next instant, two rows of black Maybachs drove towards him. Each vehicle was worth millions.

They came to a stop in front of Cameron.

The doors opened and dozens of men in suits and shades stepped out. They formed a straight line in front of Cameron before bowing to him.

"We are here on behalf of Lord Blackheart, Mr. Morgan!" They cried out in unison.
Chapter 2
Cameron wasn't too shocked by the grand display before him.

"Greetings, Mr. Morgan!" They all said.

Cameron nodded and hummed in assent before getting into one of the cars.

He answered the call on his phone at the same time.

"Sir!" A man said with the utmost respect over the call.

"Blackheart," Cameron said gently.

"Welcome back, sir! In the time that you were gone, I kept all two hundred billion worth of assets from all 150 companies in your name safe and sound. Now that you're back, I'll transfer them back to you."

"You don't have to rush it. You know I've gotten used to a slower pace these past five years."

"That woman was the one who dragged you down," Blackheart said coldly. "Do you need me to bankrupt her company, sir?"

That woman's company wouldn't have developed so successfully all these years if it weren't for Cameron instructing them to make sure it was so. How else would she have gotten into the top ten list of businessmen in Yrando?

That ungrateful woman!

"No need. Leave her be," Madison said lightly.

There was no need to make things too harsh right now. They used to be married, after all.

Plus, Cameron no longer had any feelings towards Madison after seeing her true colors. From now on, they walked separate paths.

"Yes, sir!" Blackheart responded firmly. "Do you plan to continue staying in Yrando, sir?"

"Mhm. I haven't thought of where else to go yet."

"Then I'll hand over your five companies in Yrando to you, sir!"

"You sly bastard..." Cameron chuckled, shaking his head. "Alright. Leave them to me then."

"Yes, sir. If we include the hotel, you have a total of five companies here in Yrando. Darth Holdings has the highest net worth of 30 billion and is at the top of the list of companies in Yrando. It far exceeds the second company in value."

"Darth Holdings?" Cameron's eyes glinted. "I'll head over there first then."

Darth Holdings was the first company Cameron ever established. It had a special meaning in his heart.

"When do you intend to go, sir?"

"Around 3:00 pm later."

"Alright, sir. I'll notify Mr. Kane and have him wait for you by the office entrance at 3:00 pm sharp!"

"Alright." Cameron then hung up the call.

He shook his head, thinking how Blackheart was still as strict about his duties as always.

But five years really did pass by fast. Cameron had nearly let go of everything for Madison. She had no clue of this, however.

But Cameron didn't regret doing so.

All because a plainly-dressed young girl had given him the only piece of bread in her hand 15 years ago. At the time, Cameron had been kicked out of his family due to his sickness and left to roam the streets.

The girl had told him that life was sweet when she gave him the bread.

She was quickly taken away by her caretaker, but left behind a pink hair bow which had fallen from her head.

Cameron had picked it up and swore to forever remember what she said to him.

Afterwards, he was taken away by a mysterious old man.

Not only did the old man cure his illness, but he even taught Cameron everything he knew. Cameron was thus able to find his footing at the peak of the world.

He had received many olive branches and even love letters from countless royal families in the past few years, but had refused all of them.

The only person Cameron had eyes for was the girl.

Sure enough, his efforts soon bore fruit.

He managed to locate the girl through the hair bow five years ago—Madison Parker.

Madison was a mere company employee at the time.

Cameron then chose to let go of everything and to stay by her side.

He never told Madison this.

Who knew things would come to an end like this?

Cameron had kept the hair bow all these years in a wooden box. He had placed it in the cupboard in the bedroom he and Madison shared.

He didn't bring it with him this time, because he was no longer attached to it.

Madison would soon stumble upon the hair bow and the love letters. Cameron would let her misunderstand him all she wanted. They were now divorced anyway.

They wouldn't have much opportunity to see one another in the future.

Cameron didn't plan to stay in Yrando for more than a week. He had far more important things to take care of.

"Drive around in Yrando for a bit before heading to the company," Cameron instructed the driver.

"Yes, Mr. Morgan!"

The army of Maybachs swiftly left.

Their appearance had stunned the security detail in the villa. Who was so powerful that it had to warrant such a magnificent lineup?

On the other hand, Madison received a call from her mother while cleaning up the house.

"What is it, Mom?"

"I just wanted to ask how the divorce with Cameron is going."

"It went smoothly, Mom."

"That fellow didn't take any money from you, did he?"

"Don't worry, Mom. No way would I let him take away a single cent!" Madison scoffed.

Cameron had used a lot of their resources for free in the past few years. He could dream on if he wanted compensation for the divorce!

"That's good news. By the way dear, how are things between you and Mr. Price right now?"

"It's going great, Mom," Madison replied.

"Then hurry and invite him over for dinner. Mom will make the best dishes for you two and get your wedding arranged. He's the eldest son of one of the four richest families in Yrando. If your marriage with him is set, then our future will..."

"I know, Mom. I'll tell Archie about this. I'll be going to Darth Holdings with him soon for a business meeting anyway."

"Alright dear. I won't bother you then. Bye."

"Okay, bye." Madison hung up the call.

When she thought about Archie and Cameron, her heart immediately filled with hatred towards the latter.

Madison had stayed with a weakling like Cameron for five years! If he hadn't been in her way, she would've married Archie and become Madam Price already!

Feeling angry, Madison made up a plan to throw away everything that belonged to Cameron.

When she went to the bedroom, the first thing she did was to toss all of Cameron's clothes in the cupboard to the floor.

When Madison reached the bottommost layer, she saw a wooden box. She then opened it out of curiosity.

There was a thick stack of papers in it.

Madison skimmed through them only to find that all of them were love letters addressed to Cameron. One was from Merricania's ex-president's daughter, one from Sunsettia's Princess Iracebeth...

All the writers were world famous beauties from powerful backgrounds. One of them was even from the eldest daughter of the Jones family from Andura's capital, Leving!

Madison's expression was ugly. She definitely did not believe that these letters were genuinely written to Cameron!

That meant only one thing in Madison's mind—Cameron had had secret fantasies about these women throughout their five years of marriage and thus created false love letters from them!

"That sick, filthy pervert!" Madison cursed, feeling disgusted.

She angrily slammed the box onto the floor, making the letters scatter.

A pink hair bow fell out from the box.

"What...?" Madison's eyes focused on the bow. She picked it up and looked at it, finding it familiar.

Wait.

Wasn't this the bow she and Dakota had bought together on a winter's day when they were children?

Madison had bought an exact one as Dakota back then and agreed to use this as a token of their friendship, memorializing it forever.

Madison had kept her bow safe and sound all these years.

Why would Cameron have an exact same one?

Chapter 3
Did Cameron cheat on her with Dakota behind her back?

Impossible!

Madison quickly trashed that thought.

She had never brought Cameron to meet Dakota in their five years of marriage. Plus, with Dakota's beauty and background, how would she ever set sights on a useless bum like Cameron?

Dakota's family may not be considered rich in Yrando, but they were still old blood.

Cameron must've stolen the hair bow or found it somewhere!

After all, if he could falsify this many love letters from so many beautiful women, what other heinous things couldn't he do?

For safety's sake, Madison still decided to call Dakota to make sure.

Only Madison could cheat on Cameron, not the other way around!

When Madison called Dakota however, no one picked up the call.

"She didn't pick up?" Madison wondered to herself, her brows furrowed.

Dakota should be busy with work, she thought. She would ask Dakota later then.

Madison had promised to go to Darth Holdings with Archie for the business meeting, followed by dinner. She should doll herself up in preparation.

So Madison set her phone down and put the hair bow back into its box before going to her makeup dresser.

...

Cameron arrived at Darth Holdings in his Maybach around 2:30 pm.

A familiar yet strange feeling rose in Cameron's chest as he observed the skyscraper before him.

Things had changed greatly in five years' time, including his company. That was why Cameron arrived half an hour earlier to inspect the place.

With that feeling in mind, he walked in through the front entrance.

The lobby was still set up the same, though it occupied a bigger area than before now.

"Blackheart really put in his all," Cameron commented fondly, shaking his head.

He was about to scout around the place when the elevator nearby opened its doors with a ding.

A man and woman walked out, chatting merrily.

The man wore a navy blue suit and gold-rimmed glasses. He looked to be in his late twenties. The woman was in a blue ruffled dress and makeup. Her hair had been piled high above her head.

Said woman was Madison herself.

"You're amazing, Mr. Price. I can't believe you were able to handle someone as tough as Mr. Kane. You must be getting at least one hundred million in profits if this deal goes through," Madison said cheerfully.

"Heh. Mr. Kane and I are old friends. All it takes to close the deal is a word from me."

"Are you free in the next couple of days, Mr. Price?" Madison asked.

"What is it?"

"My mother wants to meet you. She's invited you over to have dinner at our home."

"Haha, sure! She's too kind," Archie smiled in a gentlemanly way.

"Alright. I'll tell my mother." Madison smiled. She presented herself in a warm and demure manner which she never did in front of Cameron.

Cameron just so happened to witness this. But there was no emotion in his eyes.

Just then, Madison and Archie met face-to-face with Cameron at the front entrance.

Madison's expression filled with disgust the moment she saw him. "What are you doing here, Cameron?"

"If you can be here, why can't I?" Cameron said, gazing calmly at Madison.

What a small world.

"Hmph!" Madison sneered. "I'm here with Mr. Price for his business meeting. What about you? Did you come looking for a job as a security guard, or did you want to ask if we could get back together? Let me make myself clear—we are never getting back together!"

"Get back together?" Cameron sneered. "You think too much. I'm just returning to my company."

"Returning to your company?" Madison reacted as if she'd heard some great joke.

She gazed at Cameron in disgust. "Do I need to tell you where we are? This is Yrando's number one company, Darth Holdings. It's worth 30 billion on the market!"

"So?" Cameron remained calm.

"So aren't you the least bit ashamed of lying?" Madison was all the more angry seeing how calm Cameron was.

Cameron's brows furrowed. Why hadn't he realized how low-class of a person Madison was back then?

"It's alright, Madison. There's no need to get angry over someone like this," Archie piped up just then. "If he values his pride so much, then let him. You're in the list of top ten outstanding businessmen in Yrando. He's way beneath you."

Archie even shot Cameron a look of disdain when he spoke.

Archie had no respect for people like Cameron.

"You should learn proper manners and demeanor from Mr. Price, Cameron!" Madison said to Cameron.

Cameron didn't want to deal with her, so he sidestepped them and continued into the office.

"Stand right there!" Madison yelled.

"What else do you want?" Cameron asked, brows knit tight.

"We haven't settled the divorce compensation yet," Madison snapped.

"I don't need compensation, just the divorce. You don't have to worry about me being a bother to you from now on," Cameron said.

He then turned to leave.

"Compensate you? Did you seriously think I'd do that?" Madison scowled.

"Then what do you mean?" Cameron asked coldly, turning back to her.

"I'm the one who needs compensation from you for causing me mental distress during our five years of marriage!"

"Me? Cause you mental distress?" Cameron was taken aback.

He then sneered and said, "I need to compensate you for mental distress when you're the one who cheated on me? Married couples usually still treat one another decently no matter what. Did you have to resort to such cruelty?"

"Married couple? You dare bring that up?" Madison said sarcastically as she glared at Cameron. "I writhe in disgust the moment I see you. I never imagined you would be such a perverted person!"

"How am I perverted?" Cameron questioned.

"Tell me what all those love letters are about then?" Madison retorted.

Cameron's eyes widened just the slightest. So Madison did find those letters.

That means she would've seen the hair bow.

Did she really not remember at all?

Though Cameron did not want to bother with explanations, he still said, "Those letters are all genuine."

"Bullcrap!" Madison barked. "Who do you think you are having royals and politicians writing love letters to you? Have you even looked at yourself?"

"Did that really happen, Madison?" Archie had a look of disbelief on his face.

"Yes, Mr. Price. This man secretly wrote tons of fake love letters to himself and even stole a woman's hair bow! He disgusts me to no end!

"Hahaha!" Archie laughed out loud and patted Cameron on the shoulder. "You're really something, man. Respect!"

Cameron said nothing, though his face soon started turning dark.

He looked at Madison and said, "We used to be married. Did you have to slander me like that?"

"Slander? Who do you think you are? Why would you be worried about slander if you didn't do all that?"

"I've already told you what those love letters are about. But isn't that hair bow yours?" Cameron asked.

"No way! I kept my bow in my own drawer! Now tell me where you got that bow from. Did you steal it from my best friend?"

"Your best friend?" Something imploded in Cameron's mind.

Had he gotten it wrong all these years?
Chapter 4
Cameron was stunned.

So he had gotten it wrong all these years. There was another hair bow exactly like the one he had! The kind girl from those years ago wasn't Madison!

"Oh? Was I correct?" Madison's tone was even more disgusted now as she thought she was right about Cameron's actions.

Cameron's mind was buzzing. He wasn't listening to Madison at all.

"Why aren't you talking? Weren't you being so talkative earlier? Cat got your tongue?" Madison pressed on.

She got more and more agitated as she spoke. "How could I have spent five years with someone like you? I'm warning you, Cameron Morgan–if you don't compensate me for mental distress, then I'm never letting you off! You sick pervert! How long have you had your eyes on my best friend?"

"Can you shut up?" Cameron gazed sternly at Madison after returning to his senses. "I have never stolen your best friend's belongings!"

He was feeling too overwhelmed right now yet there was still irritating noise around him.

Madison was stunned.

Did Cameron... just yell at her?

Cameron had been nothing but gentle and meek towards Madison throughout their five years together!

"Ahh!" Madison got angrier the more she thought about it. She yelled at Cameron, "How dare you yell at me when you've been leeching off my resources all these years, you useless bum!"

"Can you stop yelling? Do you have any idea how annoying it is?" Cameron was getting angry at Madison. "I already told you I didn't steal your friend's stuff!"

"No? Then mind sharing where you got it from now?" Madison gritted out angrily.

"What does that have to do with you?" Cameron's eyes were cold.

"You!" Madison's face was now blotchy purple. "Is this how you behave after our divorce, Cameron? I was really blind to have decided to be with a useless, mentally unstable pervert like you. You're disgusting! If you don't compensate me today, then I'll..."

"Just tell me how much money you want!" Cameron interrupted her.

He was not in the mood to argue with Madison. All he wanted to do was find the hair bow's actual owner!

Cameron's directness stunned Madison for a moment.

But Madison swiftly grew disdainful upon recalling how Cameron was like.

"One million. I want you to compensate me with a million dollars!" Madison demanded immediately.

A million dollars was nothing much to her, but she knew this was a sky high amount to Cameron.

Cameron could barely dish out a hundred dollars, not to mention one million.

Madison clearly intended to embarrass Cameron greatly in public. Who gave him the guts to treat her his way, she thought meanly.

"Alright." Cameron didn't waste anymore time.

"Did you hear me clearly? I want one million dollars!" Madison snapped.

"I'm not deaf," Cameron replied coldly.

He knew what Madison intended to do. But did she really think he was still the old Cameron?

"Alright. Then hurry up and get me the money. I want it right now!" Madison demanded.

She wanted to see how Cameron was going to get all that money!

Cameron calmly took out his phone and called Blackheart. "Have someone bring one million dollars in cash to the company right now, Blackheart. I have an urgent need for it."

"Right away, sir. I'll have Mr. Kane get the money ready for you!"

After hanging up, Cameron said to Madison, "Just wait for two minutes. I've asked someone to bring the cash here."

"Hah!" Madison scoffed sarcastically. "You're able to get money with just a phone call? Who do you think you are? The son of the richest family in Yrando?

"And did I hear correctly? Did you just call Blackheart? Do you have any idea who Blackheart is? He's the richest man in the world! Can you invent a name we've never heard of next time? Or else you'd just be embarrassing yourself!"

Cameron ignored her, making Madison grind her teeth in anger.

What was a poor bum like him doing putting up such an act in front of her?

Tick tock. A minute soon went by.

There was still no activity from the office.

Madison urged impatiently, "Two minutes have passed. Where is this person you mentioned?"

Cameron stayed silent. He was internally counting the seconds.

Half a minute more.

"Playing dumb again, are you?" Madison gloated.

"Heh," Archie sneered and shook his head. "Forget it, Madison. You know he won't be able to fork out the cash. Let's not waste our time on someone like him. Don't forget we still have a dinner date.

"Hey kid, I'll pay this one million on your behalf. Think of it as repayment for taking care of Madison all these years for me. Take this as a reminder to not be someone who is all bark and no bite."

Archie then wrapped his arm around Madison's waist like he'd just won a competition.

"You're so gracious, dear," Madison snaked an arm around Archie's and kissed his cheek, intending to piss off Cameron.

Cameron remained calm.

Now that he knew the hair bow didn't belong to Madison, she was no longer of any significance to him.

So why would Cameron have any emotions for a complete stranger?

"You're lucky this time, Cameron. You better thank Mr. Price for his kindness!" Madison said, oblivious to Cameron's thoughts.

The two then left the office building together.

Shortly after they left, the elevator doors opened again. Two minutes on the dot.

A sweaty man in a black suit sporting a large belly was hurrying two of his subordinates in the elevator. "Hurry up! If we slow Mr. Morgan down in any way, none of us are keeping our jobs!"

"Yes, Mr. Kane!" The two employees dragged a large bag between them as they walked out.

The moment the suited man looked up, he spotted Cameron standing by the front entrance. He then quickly ran over, saying, "Mr. Morgan!"
Chapter 5
"I have the money you need, Mr. Morgan!" Bobby Kane cried, running over to Cameron.

"You must be Mr. Kane," Cameron said gently.

"You can just call me Bob, sir!" Bobby wiped away the sweat on his brow. He looked panicked. "Why didn't you inform me before your arrival, Mr. Morgan? I deeply apologize for making you wait so long out here!"

The man before Bobby was his big boss Lord Blackheart's superior! One word from him could decide Bobby's fate!

"You don't need to be worried, Mr. Kane. Plus, you weren't late. I was the one who arrived early," Cameron said with a smile.

Bobby was touched. He'd thought Cameron would be a cruel, cold-blooded man. Who knew he was actually so courteous and humble!

"Thank you, Mr. Morgan!" Bobby said gratefully. "Here is the one million dollars you needed, sir!"

"You can take it back. I don't need it anymore." Cameron shook his head. "I apologize for making you come all this way for nothing."

"Not at all, sir!" Bobby said fearfully. "Did something happen earlier, Mr. Morgan?"

"Nothing much. Just a little interruption. By the way, do you know who Archie Price is?"

"Archie Price?" Bobby asked, then nodded. "Oh, you mean him. He's the eldest son of the Price family, one of the four strongest families here in Yrando. His father Magnus Price works with our company on some projects.

"He Just came by earlier on behalf of his father to discuss a joint venture for a project in the city. He offered 30 percent of the profits to us. Do you know him, Mr. Morgan?"

Cameron shook his head. "No, I was just asking."

But Bobby thought differently. Bobby was naturally no ordinary man, being able to attain Blackheart's approval and become CEO of Darth Holdings.

Bobby immediately understood the underlying meaning in Cameron's words.

Bobby then said lightly, "I don't think the Price family is genuine regarding the joint venture. Why don't we leave this business opportunity to someone else?"

"Yes." Cameron nodded.

Bobby secretly sighed in relief. Looks like he was right.

He then said respectfully, "Why don't I take you on a tour around the company, Mr. Morgan?"

"Maybe next time, Mr. Kane. I have some urgent matters to tend to right now," Cameron said.

All Cameron could think about was the hair bow. Based on what Madison said earlier, the hair bow probably belonged to one of her best friends.

"Alright, Mr. Morgan. Do contact me whenever you're free. Here's my card!" Bobby handed Cameron his name card.

Cameron accepted it with a smile. "Okay, Mr. Kane. You'll be further needed to help manage the company from now on."

"It is my honor to serve the company, Mr. Morgan," Bobby said earnestly. To prove his determination, he added, "I'll have my driver escort you wherever you wish to go later, sir!"

"That won't be necessary. I'll head there on my own."

"Alright, sir."

Cameron turned away, about to leave.

Just then, a young woman in an off-white dress walked into the front entrance.

She had long hair and looked to be in her late twenties. She hurried inside, nearly bumping right into Cameron.

"I'm so sorry!" She apologized to him.

Cameron gazed at her, finding her strangely familiar. However, they had never met one another prior to this.

The woman didn't have the energy to mind anything else. After apologizing to Cameron, she turned to the elevator.

Just then, she spotted Bobby standing beside Cameron. Surprise flitted across her eyes. "What a coincidence, Mr. Kane!"

She had come here just to meet Bobby Kane!

"Good afternoon, Ms. Dakota," Bobby greeted politely with a smile.

Dakota Jennings then handed him the proposal she brought. "This is my family's proposal for your company's project in the city, Mr. Kane. Please take a look."

Dakota was feeling nervous because this was the last hope her family had of saving itself!

The Jennings family was old blood in Yrando. Even though they were no match for the wealthiest families, they were still of some standing.

But in recent months they had accrued a large debt due to the gambling addiction of Dakota's grandfather. Her father's business failure only added to her family's troubles.

If it weren't for the Jennings family's reputation, they would've long gone bankrupt.

Now that they wanted to make a comeback, all their hopes were placed on the partnership with Darth Holdings. They wanted to rely on Darth Holdings' reputation in Yrando!

Because of this, Dakota had amended countless proposals for the project. She was confident in her proposal writing skills.

But after taking Dakota's proposal, Bobby merely skimmed through it before closing it back up.

Dakota's brows furrowed. She asked nervously, "Is there something wrong with the proposal, Mr. Kane?"

"To be honest with you, Ms. Dakota, this company has always chosen to work with reputable businesses. As far as I'm concerned, your family is currently facing a financial crisis..." Bobby went straight to the point. He didn't want to waste any time.

Bobby had long known about the Jennings family situation. There was no way Darth Holdings would work with them.

Bobby's words quelled Dakota's hope. But she still didn't give up because this was her family's last chance.

Dakota balled her hands into fists and said fervently, "Mr. Kane, if you're concerned about my family's financial issues, then I can promise you we won't let you down! And if you accept this proposal, I can split your company 50 to 60 percent of the profits, on behalf of my family."

"The Jennings family? Dakota Jennings?" Cameron's thought to himself as his eyes glinted.

Only then did he realize the woman standing before him was the daughter of the Jennings family from Yrando, as well as Madison's best friend.

Though Cameron had never seen Dakota in person, he'd heard of her from Madison before. Coupled with how Cameron felt Dakota was strangely familiar at first sight earlier, could that mean Dakota was the girl from...

"I'm sorry, Ms. Dakota. I appreciate your proposal but I really cannot help you here," Bobby said, interrupting Cameron's thoughts.

"Please put your faith in me this once, Mr. Kane!" Dakota begged. She couldn't lose this business deal.

"I truly am sorry, Ms. Dakota." Bobby shook his head.

"Mr. Kane, I..." Dakota wanted to insist once more on a chance, but when she saw the impatience in Bobby's eyes, she knew he would only find her more irritating if she continued.

So Dakota had no choice but to give up. She said dejectedly, "I understand, Mr. Kane. I apologize for wasting your time."

Dakota turned around, preparing to leave.

Just then, Cameron suddenly spoke up, "Mr. Kane, I think Ms. Dakota is a decent and genuine young woman. Why don't you consider her proposal?"

Dakota was stunned. She turned around to look at Cameron, feeling deeply grateful.

But she knew there was no one in Yrando that could sway Bobby Kane's decision...

🪔 || Shravan Purnima Special || 🪔

🔱Auspicious Puja for the Last Shravan Monday🔱

🙏Lakshmi Narayan Havan and Gau Pujan🙏

For Blessings of Prosperity and Opulence in Family

🛕Etteluthuperumal Temple, Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu🛕

According to Hindu Panchang, there are 12 months in a year, and among these, four months—Vaishakh, Shravan, Kartik, and Magh—are considered the most auspicious. Among them, the month of Sawan is dedicated to Lord Shiva. In this holy month, in addition to Lord Shiva, the worship of other deities also holds special significance. The Purnima falling in the month of Shravan is considered extremely auspicious and important. Although there is a tradition of worshipping Lakshmi Narayan on every Purnima, the significance of this worship increases even more on Shravana Purnima. Goddess Lakshmi is known as the goddess of wealth, and Lord Vishnu is one of the principal deities of Sanatan Dharma, also known as Narayan and Hari. Lord Vishnu is regarded as the preserver of the universe. On one hand, the worship of Goddess Lakshmi brings wealth, happiness, and prosperity, and on the other hand, worshipping Lakshmi along with Lord Vishnu fulfils all the desires of the devotees. It is said that those who feel a lack of wealth in business and jobs should worship Lakshmi Narayan. This worship bestows the blessings of both Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi.

Additionally, performing the Gau Pujan along with Lakshmi Narayan Havan on the auspicious occasion of Shravana Purnima is considered highly beneficial. In Hinduism, the cow is worshipped as Gau Mata. It is believed that 33 Koti deities reside within the Gau Mata. According to the Vishnu Purana, if one worships and serves the cow on the day of Purnima, Lord Vishnu becomes extremely pleased and fulfils one's wishes quickly, as Lord Vishnu himself served Gau Mata in the form of Lord Krishna. Therefore, on the auspicious occasion of Shravana Purnima, a Lakshmi Narayan Havan and Gau Pujan will be organised at the Etteluthuperumal Temple in Tirunelveli. This temple also has a Gau Shala, which is said to be the first temple Gau Shala in India, where more than 900 cows are cared for. Participate in this sacred Havan and Gau Pujan through Shri Mandir and receive the blessings of Lakshmi Narayan.

Eating out is often considered unhealthy, but it doesn't have to be! By choosing restaurants that use high-quality ingredients and healthy cooking oils, you can enjoy dining out while still maintaining a nutritious diet.

Take McDonald's as an example. They used to cook their fries in beef tallow with just three ingredients: potato, beef tallow, and salt. This simple approach made for a healthier option. Nowadays, McDonald's fries contain 19 ingredients, many of which are additives and less healthy.

The key to healthy eating out is to seek out places that prioritize simple, wholesome ingredients. Look for restaurants that use natural, unprocessed ingredients and avoid those that rely heavily on additives and low-quality oils. Not only will your meals be healthier, but they'll also taste better.

Eating out can be both enjoyable and nutritious when you make informed choices. Want to learn more tips on how to eat healthy even when dining out?

"Ding! The system is generating..."
"Ding! The system has successfully bound to host!"
Adrien quickly knew that he had won the biggest prize in the entire galaxy, an almighty system! 🎁🎁🎁
"Yes!" Adrien jumped up and down in excitement. 🤩🤩🤩
"Ding! Detected that the host's bank card only has a remaining balance of three dollars. Detected that the host was just humiliated by his ex-girlfriend and her sugar daddy."
"Ding! The host's Reburg Bank card has received a payment of 40 thousand dollars!💸💸💸 Triggering the first task: Face-slapping! Host, please go to the Fendi store in Reburg Center Mall and spend 40 thousand dollars immediately!"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
📚An Almighty System From On High📚

Chapter 1 He Won A System

"Carrie! Why do you treat me like this? For the past three or four years, I have given you my heart and soul! I saved money and gave all my money to you, just to show you my sincerity! Why do you still abandon me and be with this middle-aged fat man?"
The boy grabbed the girl's hand and pointed at the fat old man in his forties aside, completely unable to control his emotions.
"Smack!"
Adrien Higgins looked at Carrie Archer in disbelief as she heartlessly slapped away his hand.
"Don't touch me!! Adrien Higgins, let me tell you! You are just an ordinary university classmate of mine! What you've spent on me, including your time and money, means nothing to me. My heart belongs to Mr. Irwin, the man standing in front of you! You'd better show some respect to me! Don't you dare lay a finger on me!"
Adrien looked at his girlfriend of three years, who had suddenly turned to another man, and tears welled up in Adrien's eyes.
"No!! You're lying to me!"
"I'm lying to you? Who do you think you are? Why should I lie to you? Look at you! You have no talent or money. You've already graduated from college but don't even have a stable job! And you want to pick up girls? You are a loser, a piece of trash. Stay away from me! Otherwise, my honey will make you stay away!"
Carrie did not hide her aversion and disgust toward Adrien at all.
"Honey, let's go. I don't really know this person. We were just classmates before. It's such a bummer that we encounter him. I feel like I'm contaminated by his poverty! You must buy me a new outfit later. I've already selected a Fendi suit that's especially suitable for my delicate figure!"
"Kid, let me tell you! My woman is not someone you can touch! You just touched her hand! You must pay me 3,000 dollars in! Give the money, or you will never see the sun rise again!"
Adrien looked at the two in disbelief, filled with anger. "I'll never see the sun rise again? What can you do to me? I've been an orphan since childhood, with no one to rely on! You wanna kill me? Come on!"
Adrien was driven mad by his wrath. Wayne Irwin came up to Adrien and slapped Adrien twice in the face. "Kid! I'll punch your lights out every time I see you!"
Adrien lowered his head in silence. The pain in his heart was far greater than the pain in his face.
"You loser. If it wasn't for the fact that you were popular and worked hard to earn money to spend on me when we were in college, did you really think I would have noticed someone like you without any background or ability? Hah, you'd better stay away from me in the future! Don't ever come to me again!" Carrie spoke with extreme disdain in Adrien's ear.
Her words were like a dagger digging into his heart.
Adrien watched as the two walked away side by side, the pain on his face bringing him a moment of clarity.
He worked so hard for three years just to see Carrie's smile. Now it seemed that Adrien was nothing but a stepping stone for her.
Carrie had ruthlessly trampled on Adrien's face and shattered all his hopes and dreams for the future.
The gloomy sky over Reburg was terrifying, and the invisible infrabar caused pedestrians to quicken their pace, afraid of being caught off guard by a sudden downpour.
Adrien walked alone on the street, watching as the storm approached with roaring winds, and the anger in his heart burst forth.
"You adulterers!! You two will die in misery!"
After a tirade of curses, people passing by Adrien thought Adrien was crazy, hurrying past Adrien.
Suddenly, the wind seemed to grow stronger and stronger, and Adrien could barely keep his eyes open.
After a final howling wind, he felt dizzy, and his head began to throb.
"Ding! The system is generating..."
"Ding! The system has successfully bound to host!"
Hearing that, Adrien quickly knew that he had won the biggest prize in the entire galaxy, an almighty system!
"Yes!" Adrien jumped up and down in excitement.
"Ding! Detected that the host's bank card only has a remaining balance of three dollars. Detected that the host was just humiliated by his ex-girlfriend. Triggering the first task: Wreak vengeance on her. Host, please go to the Fendi store in Reburg Center Mall and spend 40 thousand dollars immediately!"
Adrien was dumb upon hearing the system's words. He didn't even have four dollars, let alone 40 thousand dollars!
However, Adrien also knew the system wouldn't issue stupid tasks. It must have a second step! And he would have the money.
"Ding! The host's Reburg Bank card has received a payment of 40 thousand dollars!"
The system was indeed reliable! Adrien couldn't wait to see the expression on Carrie when she saw that Adrien didn't hesitate to spend 40 thousand dollars.
Suddenly, there was a loud rumble as heavy rain poured down on Reburg!
Adrien ran in the rain. He was not far away from the Reburg Center Mall, so he thought taking a taxi for such a short distance was a waste of money!
However, Adrien underestimated the power of the heavy rain. Within minutes, he was completely soaked and embarrassed when he arrived.
As soon as Adrien walked into Reburg Center Mall, the security guard at the entrance stopped Adrien.
"What? I got soaked, and I want to buy some clothes."
"Ahem, nothing, sir." The security guard thought Adrien was just seeking shelter from the rain and didn't expect Adrien to be there to shop.
After entering the mall, Adrien was shocked by its luxurious decor. A blast of cold air conditioning blew toward him, but it also ignited the flames of revenge in his heart!
Following the signs inside the mall, Adrien arrived at the Fendi store.

Chapter 2 Slap In The Face

Adrien stood wet outside the door of the Fendi store.
"Sir?"
"I just got soaked by the rain. So I want to buy some clothes that I can change into immediately. You know, it's uncomfortable to be all wet like this."
"I see. Please come in." The service assistant couldn't drive Adrien away since Adrien was a customer, even though Adrien didn't look well-dressed.
Adrien heard Carrie's voice from afar saying, "Honey, is this outfit nice?" Adrien looked over in the direction of her voice and coincidentally bumped into her face-to-face!
"Adrien Higgins! I told you not to follow me anymore! How dare you follow me here!" Carrie shouted.
Adrien turned his head as if he hadn't heard Carrie and continued to browse the clothes.
"How dare you play dumb with me?!" Carrie walked up to Adrien, but Adrien still ignored her as if she were invisible.
"Waitress, you better open your eyes wide so that people with only several dollars in their pockets won't come here and pick out clothes worth thousands of dollars!" Carrie pointed at Adrien and said arrogantly.
Adrien remained unmoved, continuing to choose suitable clothes for himself. It was not surprising that he was attracted to the clothes. He started working part-time in his sophomore year, and most of the money he earned was given to Carrie, only left some for daily use. To put it nicely, Adrien was a man who loved his wife. To put it bluntly, he was a lickspittle who was eventually cruelly abandoned by his lover!
"Sir, these clothes are all priced above 15 hundred dollars each. If you really don't plan to buy them, then please don't touch them. After all, we need to compensate for any damages." The service assistant couldn't bear to watch the scene any longer.
"Did you hear that, you beggar? Who gave you the courage to follow me to a store like this?! Honey, that poor loser is ruining our moods again!"
"I told you before! If I see you again, I'll hit you again! It seems like you have a short memory! You just got beaten up, and now you want some more, right?" Wayne walked toward Adrien with his fists clenched.
Adrien didn't even bother to look at Wayne since Wayne was just a sucker. Now that Adrien had a system, there was no need for Adrien to argue with Wayne. Adrien picked out two shirts and two pairs of pants and handed them to the service assistant. "Hold onto these four for me."
"You're just putting on airs. I know how much you have exactly!" Carrie sneered from the side, making the service assistant hesitant about Adrien's intention.
"If you know everything, do you know how much money I spent on you over the past three years?"
"That's because you were willing to spend it on me! You have no job, no background, and not even parents. You should be grateful that anyone wanted to be with you. I must be blind, for I actually wasted three years of my life with someone like you!"
"Carrie Archer, you spent nearly 30 thousand dollars of my money in the past three years."
"Three years? You were only giving me 700 dollars a month. How dare you calculate the total cost over three years!"
"You're right. You're absolutely right! So, where are the clothes your rich honey bought for you?" Adrien continued to browse the clothes without looking at Wayne or even Carrie.
Carrie immediately shook the clothes in her hand in front of Adrien.
"Look at this suit. It's customized and costs ten thousand dollars. It's what you spent on me in a year. With a honey like this, do I need someone like you?"
"Go pay for it now. Then put it on immediately and make your sugar daddy happy!"
"Adrien! Can't you speak properly and decently? He's my husband! My honey!"
"Did you get married? Calling an old man who's 20 or 30 years older than you like that, huh? His son must be older than you, right?" Adrien had cooled down at that moment and was being all sarcastic. He didn't seem like the person who was hesitant to compete with others without a system earlier. It surprised Carrie. Upon reflection, it was understandable that Adrien had worked different jobs and met different people in the past three years.
"You little brat, I believe you're looking for trouble!" Wayne, who was standing next to them, was furious when he heard Adrien's words. Although Wayne had a wife and child and was just playing around with Carrie, he couldn't bear to hear something so insulting said in public.
"Sir! If you're here to buy something, please watch your language. If not, I'll call security to escort you out!" The service assistant who held Adrien's clothes also spoke coldly to Adrien.
"Are you deaf? This woman has been insulting me since I entered. You didn't say anything just because she dressed nicely? I talked back to her, and now you want to kick me out? Remember who you are. You're just a service assistant. What makes you think you can yell at me?" Adrien's aura wasn't something that a recent graduate could be easily released but rather resembled those high-level rich people!
Another service assistant hurried over to stop her colleague, Janice, from arguing with the customer.
"Okay, okay, Sir. Let me serve you instead! Janice, you go serve this lady!"
"You poor loser, I'm watching you. Let's see if you can pay for your purchase!"
"Why don't you go pay for your own clothes first and then enjoy the show!"
"Honey, he's insulting me!" Carrie whined to Wayne.
"Waitress, the bill now!" Wayne took Carrie to handle the payment and then stood at the checkout counter, waiting to see Adrien make a fool of himself.
Adrien browsed for a while, and the service assistant behind him was holding a dozen or so clothes and was getting impatient, but she didn't show it.
"Let's go. I'll pay and change into these clothes. And I'll throw away what I'm wearing now."
When Adrien spoke, the service assistant hesitated and came to the checkout counter. Carrie rushed to Adrien's side and shouted, "I suggest you call the police. This person doesn't have any money. He's just here to play with you!"
The cashier nervously scanned the price tags and said, "Sir, you have thirteen items. That'll be 31 thousand dollars in total."
Adrien handed over his Reburg Bank card, and the cashier saw it was just an ordinary debit card. She immediately became stern and said, "Sir, you're disrupting public order by doing this! I will report you to the police."
"You're going to report me before you even swipe my card? Debit cards can't be swiped? Or is it that your little Fendi store's market value is higher than Reburg Bank's? Maybe your parent company has a higher market value than Reburg Bank, but you? Please swipe the card, waitress!"
"Hmph, what if your card doesn't work?" The cashier at the counter picked up Adrien's debit card and swiped it. Adrien calmly entered his password.
The receipt then came out!
Everyone around was dumbfounded!
"That's impossible! How could you have over 30 thousand dollars!" Carrie exclaimed in disbelief.
Ignoring her, Adrien took out a few clothes from his purchase and walked into the dressing room alone to change.
Soon, a handsome and decent young man appeared before everyone's eyes.
Adrien walked up to Carrie and whispered, "There's a beautiful bag in the back that suits your skin tone very well. Go take a look and let your sugar dad... Oh, no. Let your husband buy it for you."
Carrie was taken aback by Adrien's sudden change, but as soon as she heard his words, she couldn't help but want to see the bag. After all, Adrien had always had good taste, and she had really liked the few small gifts he had given her before, but things had changed since then.
"Honey, I'm going to take a look inside!"
"I'll go with you. And I'll buy whatever you like!"
Wayne's words greatly increased Carrie's confidence.
The two of them went to the bag section, and Carrie spotted the bag that Adrien had recommended to her at a glance.

Chapter 3 A Porsche From The System

"Miss, this bag costs 40 thousand dollars! You have great taste. The design and material of this bag are top-notch. Look at the color. It suits you very well. The designer of the clothes you just bought is the same as that of this bag. If you wear the clothes with this bag, you'll look even more youthful and beautiful." The service assistant's words made Carrie very happy.
"Honey, it's only 40 thousand dollars. It's not expensive! Buy it for me now!" Carrie spoke to Wayne in a demanding tone.
Wayne was very unhappy when he heard that. He didn't treat Carrie by keeping a mistress as some people did. He had only agreed to take her out for dinner and buy her some things because she had just graduated from college and had no job or savings. When he heard Carrie telling him that her ex-boyfriend had been harassing her, he felt protective of her. He never expected her to be so insatiable and demanding! And he was furious!
Adrien calculated that he still needed to spend about 9 thousand dollars to complete his mission, so he continued to browse around and picked up two pairs of shoes. As Adrien was paying, he suddenly heard a quarrel from the bag section. Adrien smirked triumphantly.
"You piece of trash! Who do you think you are? How dare you ask me to buy such an expensive bag! I've already done you a favor by buying you this dress! You really have no shame!" Then came the sound of a slap!
Hearing the sound of the slap, Adrien knew that it was definitely much harsher than the two slaps he had received earlier. But he was determined to get revenge for those two slaps in the future!
"I'll use this card to pay!" Adrien handed over the debit card he had just used to make the payment.
"Yes, Sir! We're sorry for offending you earlier. Please forgive us!"
Adrien had just finished paying when Wayne came to the checkout counter with the clothes he had bought for Carrie.
"Return this dress for me right now! Process it immediately!"
"Honey, please don't do that! I don't want that bag anymore! Don't return my dress!" Adrien watched the drama show with great satisfaction.
"You whore! You think I'm a cash cow, huh? Do you think I'm like that stupid boy? I just wanted to play with you! Remember that!"
"Honey! I don't want that bag anymore! I'm sorry!" Carrie immediately took on a pitiful and regretful attitude.
Adrien saw how cheap the person he used to like had become and lost his desire for revenge.
As Adrien walked past Carrie with his clothes, he muttered quietly, "How pathetic!"
Carrie looked at Adrien's back with hatred, but more than that, she felt regret!
As Adrien walked out of the Fendi store, he heard the sound he had been waiting for in his mind.
"Ding! The host has completed the face-slapping mission and received a cash reward of three thousand dollars. The money has been deposited to your account in real-time!"
"System, is the money legal?"
Adrien asked nervously.
"Please rest assured, Host. All money, assets, task rewards, technology distribution, and lottery draws by the system are traceable and completely legal. Please feel free to use them!"
The system's words reassured Adrien, who then went to a restaurant to have a nice meal as a celebration!
As Adrien walked out of the restaurant after finishing his meal, he saw a middle-aged man who seemed to be feeling unwell suddenly falling to the ground. The people and security guards around the middle-aged man immediately rushed over.
"Are you okay? Wake up!" The security guard was trying to wake the middle-aged man up.
Adrien squeezed in and saw what had happened. He had previously worked part-time helping people as a guide and orientation counselor at the hospital and had been trained in professional cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
"Everyone, please step back and keep the air flowing!" Adrien instructed, pointing to the security guard. "Call an ambulance immediately!"
Adrien shouted at the middle-aged man and began to perform professional chest compressions and artificial respiration on the man when he saw that there was no response.
Not long after, the middle-aged man suddenly regained consciousness!
The people around breathed a sigh of relief.
"Are you okay, sir?" Adrien asked.
"What happened just now?" the middle-aged man asked.
"You passed out. This young man saved you. I've already called 911, and the ambulance will be here soon. I suggest you go to the hospital to get checked out!" the security guard explained.
"Oh! Thank you very much, young man! I have had heart trouble since birth. I felt suffocated just now, and then I lost consciousness!"
"Do you have any medication with you, sir?" Adrien asked with concern.
"I forgot to bring it. I tend to forget things easily since I am now getting old! What's your name, young man? I need to repay you!" The man tried to stand up while reaching for his pocket.
"Sir, you'd better sit down. After a heart attack, you shouldn't move around casually, especially not stand up suddenly while sitting. I don't need you to repay me. I was just passing by. Wait for the ambulance here. I've got things to do, so I'm leaving now!"
Adrien said and left with his things. The man watched Adrien's back and sighed that there were many good people in the world.
"Mr. Keller! What happened to you?"
Suddenly, two people ran over from a distance and went to the middle-aged man's side. The security guard described what had happened, and one of them went to the surveillance room to check the situation while the other stayed with the middle-aged man.
Adrien arrived at the entrance of Reburg Center Mall. The security guard took a look at Adrien and suddenly remembered that Adrien was that wet young man. Adrien looked so different now. Although Adrien's hair was still a bit messy, Adrien had the appearance of a successful young man.
"Ding! The Host has just rescued someone enthusiastically and received an additional reward from the system! The host is awarded a Porsche roadster. Please check your car!"
After System finished speaking, Adrien felt something inexplicably appear in his pocket.
He put his hand into his pocket and pulled out the key with the Porsche logo on it, feeling excited.
"System, where's the car? I got my driver's license a long time ago, and I worked as a driver for six months! But I never had a car to drive!"
"The car is located in parking space A008 on the B3 floor of Reburg Center Mall, Host!"
Adrien held the car key in his right hand and his newly bought clothes from Fendi in his left hand, humming a song all the way to the B3 floor of the underground parking lot.
Unexpectedly, he ran into Carrie and Wayne again. One was crying and begging for forgiveness, and the other was shouting loudly!
When Carrie was pleading with Wayne, she suddenly saw Adrien walking toward the Porsche roadster on the opposite side.
"Adrien! You liar! You tricked me!" Carrie shouted in Adrien's direction.
Adrien completely ignored Carrie. Such a woman was not worth his continued infatuation. He would move on from the past three years. With the system now, he was determined to become the richest man in the universe. Carrie was nothing to him now!
Adrien composed himself and stood in front of his red Porsche roadster. It was a supercar, but he didn't know the model. Then, he finally laughed out loud, "Let me see you, my dear honey! Muah!" Adrien leaned over and kissed the car twice!
People passing by took a look and thought that Adrien was crazy. The car was good, and even the license plate was unique. The young man was also dressed well, but was it necessary to act like that toward a car? Adrien acted like he was a fetishist.

Chapter 4 Almighty System

Adrien didn't care how others looked at him. He circled around the Porsche roadster and loved the red color. He looked at the license plate number, which was a unique number, RE12345.
"What an awesome license plate number!" Adrien laughed and took out the key and pressed it lightly. The car lights flashed twice, and he quickly sat in the driver's seat.
"Wow, I'm also a car owner now!" Until now, Adrien seemed to still be in a dream. Everything came too suddenly!
"System! Are you really real?"
"Of course."
"Blessing from heaven!" Adrien laughed excitedly.
He inserted the key, turned it on, and started the car! Under Adrien's driving, the Porsche roadster rushed out with a swoosh.
Driving on the streets of Reburg, Adrien felt for the first time that life could be beautiful.
"Adrien grew up in an orphanage. When he realized he was an orphan, he became hopeless about the future. So even though he was bullied and insulted since childhood, he chose to endure it until he met the first girl who approached him actively in college, Carrie, but it turned out like that.
"
"Now, I, Adrien Higgins, am no longer the person I was! I must completely change myself!"
After driving around for a while, Adrien returned home and parked his car downstairs. When he turned around and saw his old shabby rental apartment, it formed a sharp contrast with the bright red Porsche supercar.
Back at home, he took a shower and hung up his newly bought clothes. Then he fell into a deep sleep.
Adrien slept until the evening and ordered himself a super seafood platter that he had never dared to order before, enjoying it while communicating with the system.
"System, what functions do you have? Can you tell me in detail?"
"Host, the system is an almighty system with many functions. Host, close your eyes and feel the control panel in your mind."
Following the system's instructions, Adrien closed his eyes. Then a set of very advanced-looking control panel appeared in his mind. In the clear picture, eight circular patterns revolved around the largest pattern in the center.
Among them, the largest circular logo had the word "Level" written on it, and there was also a row of small numbers below the level, which currently read 112/20000.
The eight circular keys around it were marked with the words "Blessing," "Raffles," "Skills," "Clock in," "Predictions," "Swap," "Curse," and "Technologies." However, now only the Predictions key was lit, and the other colorful keys were basically dim. In the upper right corner of the control area, there was a Square Exit key, and in the lower left corner was a Self-protection function key!
"System, I see that some of the keys are dim, meaning they are not activated. What does that mean? And what does the Level key in the middle mean?"
"The Level key means that as the host's expenses increase, the system level gradually increases from level 1, and with each upgrade, the other keys around the system will be activated. After activation, the system will become more powerful and perfect. Currently, the host is at level 1, and the EXP is 112/20000. When the host's EXP accumulates to 20,000, the system will enter an upgrade."
"I see! This system is simply perfect!" Adrien looked at the eight keys around again and silently clicked on the Predictions key!
"Ding! The host has activated the Predictions key, and the result will be refreshed soon!"
This was Adrien's first time using the system function key, so he was full of expectations!
"Ding! On March 22, 2034, the winning numbers for the national welfare lottery will be 03, 06, 15, 21, 23, 32, and 11, with a total bonus of 160 million dollars, the largest jackpot in history! Please make good use of it, Host!"
"What the heck?! The system actually gave me the winning numbers, with a bonus of 160 million dollars! I have to calculate..."
"Ding! The system version is too low. It is recommended that the host upgrade immediately tomorrow."
"Understood, System!"
Adrien was so excited that he almost didn't sleep all night. He barely fell asleep around 3 o'clock in the morning.
He slept until noon the next day, cleaned him up, put on the Fendi clothes he bought the day before, and planned to go out to buy the lottery ticket first and quickly spend money to upgrade the system!
As soon as he walked downstairs, he suddenly found that there were many people around his red Porsche roadster in front. Adrien was puzzled. Why were so many people surrounding his car?
Before he got close, he heard a woman say, "Your child drew on someone's car like this. Can't you properly teach your child?!"
"I... Misael! Look at what you've done!"
Hearing that, Adrien felt a thump in his heart. He had just gotten the Porsche roadster yesterday, and he cherished it like a treasure. Did the mischievous child graffiti on it?
He hurried over, squeezed into the crowd, and was dumbfounded on the spot!
"Damn it! My car!!"
The side door of the Porsche roadster was covered with flowers, clouds, and trees drawn by the child named Misael using water-based pens.
"The owner of the car is here!" someone said.
"Sir!! Is this your car?" a woman asked nervously.
"It's mine, and why does it look like this now?" Adrien was unhappy.
"I'm sorry, I'm really sorry! My child is too young. I didn't watch him carefully, and he drew on your car! How much will it cost to repair it? We'll compensate you!" the woman said nervously.
"This car costs over one hundred thousand dollars. You might not be able to afford it even if you sell your house!" A man who was watching the commotion remarked.
"What?! It's that expensive?!" The woman was stunned upon hearing that.
"Yeah, it's a Porsche roadster! It's rare to see it on the road. But why did you park such a nice car here?"
The woman was stunned again. Then she reached out and grabbed her child, pinched his neck tightly, and pressed hard. The child fell to his knees in front of Adrien and started crying loudly out of fear.
Adrien was speechless. He looked at the child in front of him. Misael was probably three or four years old. And the fact that the mother was still waiting there without running away showed that she had enough sense of responsibility. Adrien was not an overbearing person. After seeing that scene, he felt much less angry.
"What are you doing? Even if your child made a mistake, you can't make him kneel in front of me!"
"Waahh!! Mommy, please don't hit me anymore!" Misael cried miserably as the woman gave him a series of slaps on his buttocks.

Chapter 5 Sudden Raffle

"Waahh!! Mommy, please don't hit me anymore!" Misael cried miserably as the woman gave him a series of slaps on his buttocks.
"How could you?! Do you know how big of a problem you've caused? This car is so expensive. Why can't you be more responsible!" The woman's screams scared Misael into silence and tears.
"I'm really sorry, sir. How should we compensate you? It's my fault. I was negligent with my child. I'm really sorry!" The woman apologized while also being frightened.
Adrien felt helpless. Everyone who lived there was poor. How could he force a poor person to sell their house to pay for his car's repair costs? That would be like pushing someone to death.
Adrien asked in his mind, "System, does this car have insurance?"
"All the things that the system gives to the host are complete sets. The insurance is of the highest level!"
Adrien walked over to Misael, helped him up, and said, "Misael, your parents work hard to raise you. You can't just destroy other people's property. Do you understand?"
"I understand now. Sir, I'm sorry!" Misael apologized tearfully to Adrien.
"If you're still not satisfied, you can beat Misael up, but don't kill him!" the woman said with a hint of sorrow.
"What are you talking about? The child made a mistake, so teach him a lesson, and that's enough. As long as he remembers and doesn't make the same mistake again in the future, it will be fine. What's the point of hitting him? Even if you hit him, he might not learn anything!"
"Right, you're right. How much should I give you?"
Adrien looked at the drawings on the car and then at the pen in Misael's hand.
"Misael, you drew on my car and ruined it. As punishment, I will use this pen in your hand to draw on your face the blue sky and white clouds that you drew on my car. Do you agree?" Adrien said gently.
Misael looked confused and turned to his mother for guidance.
The woman repeatedly nodded her head, and then Misael handed the pen to Adrien. Adrien took the pen and started drawing on Misael's face.
After a while, Misael's face was covered with messy drawings, which made everyone around them laugh. Misael wanted to see himself, so Adrien picked Misael up and let Misael see himself from the car window.
"It looks really ugly!"
"So you can't do this again in the future, okay?"
"Yes. I'll be good from now on!"
"Good. Now go home with your mom." Adrien's words surprised the woman and the people watching.
"You're just letting her go like that when they did this to your car?" A passerby asked.
"The child made a mistake, and I have punished him. I don't know how much it will cost to repair my car, but I can't make things difficult for a mother. This is enough. Don't surround us anymore. I have things to do and need to leave!"
"You... you're such a good person! Thank you!" The woman and Misael bowed to Adrien, who waved his hand and drove away.
As Adrien left the residential area, he looked at the damage to his car again and felt heartbroken. He took out his phone and called the dealership. After learning that it could be repaired, he made an appointment at three o'clock in the afternoon and then went to look for the lottery store!
On the way, Adrien searched for the store. Suddenly, the system notification sound popped up again in his mind!
"Ding, the host is considerate in handling matters and has won one Raffle! Would the host like to Raffle now?"
Hearing the system's words, Adrien felt much more psychologically balanced!
"Not now! Later!"
The most important thing now was not the Raffle or repairing the car but buying lottery tickets and upgrading the system at the same time!
Adrien arrived at a lottery store on Reburg Central Avenue. He handed over a set of numbers that he had written down.
"Sir, I want the number with a two hundred times multiplier! Take a good look, and don't get the wrong numbers!"
"Two hundred times? Young man, you're really confident," the man chuckled and shook his head, not believing that Adrien could win.
"I'm really lucky lately!" Adrien said. After getting the lottery ticket, he put it in his phone case and left!
Once outside the lottery store, Adrien took out the lottery ticket and looked at it carefully for a long time. He still couldn't figure out what was so special about his ticket. He then glanced at his phone, which he had bought second-hand four years ago when he just started college. The camera sucked. It was time to upgrade!
Adrien stepped on the gas pedal and arrived at a nearby shopping mall. He walked into a phone store.
"Hello, sir. What would you like to see?"
"I want to buy a new phone. What are the prices?"
"They range from over nine hundred dollars to more than 17 hundred dollars."
"Give me the one that costs 17 hundred dollars, and select a tablet for me. Together, they should be less than 3,000 dollars!"
"Okay, sir. Please wait a moment."
Shortly after, Adrien put the lottery ticket worth 160 million dollars in his newly purchased phone case. He checked his account balance, which was still more than 110 dollars. He then went to the car store.
Adrien was not familiar with the car store. He just parked his car outside and made a phone call. Then, a customer service representative came to take his car key. Before leaving, Adrien asked about the repair cost, but the other party said it was covered by insurance, so Adrien didn't need to pay anything. They would contact him when the car was fixed.
Adrien took his new phone and tablet and returned to his house in the taxi. Suddenly, his phone rang, and Adrien was not used to it!
"Hello?"
"Hey, Adrien! What have you been up to lately?" It was Kamron Frost, Adrien's college buddy.
"I haven't been doing much these days. Just staying at home."
"Are you working today? If you're free, come out for dinner tonight! Let's go to that restaurant outside our college! I just got paid today, so I'll treat our dorm mates to a meal! You have to come! It's been a long time since the four of us got together!" Kamron said.
"No problem! What time?" asked Adrien.
"6:30 pm. See you tonight!" replied Kamron.
"After hanging up the phone, Adrien felt very happy. During his four years of college, besides his three roommates who never looked down on him and always helped him, he had almost no other friends. Adrien always kept the friendship in mind, and if he ever became successful in the future, he would definitely help his three buddies out!
"
"System! You mentioned that there was one chance for a Raffle before! What is that?" Adrien asked.
"The host handles things very tactfully and has received an extra Raffle from the system as a reward. Would the host like to Raffle now?" the system replied.
--------------------------------------------------
