Adrien quickly knew that he had won the biggest prize in the entire galaxy, an almighty system! 🎁🎁🎁
"Yes!" Adrien jumped up and down in excitement. 🤩🤩🤩
"Ding! Detected that the host's bank card only has a remaining balance of three dollars. Detected that the host was just humiliated by his ex-girlfriend and her sugar daddy."
"Ding! The host's Reburg Bank card has received a payment of 40 thousand dollars!💸💸💸 Triggering the first task: Face-slapping! Host, please go to the Fendi store in Reburg Center Mall and spend 40 thousand dollars immediately!"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
📚An Almighty System From On High📚

Chapter 1 He Won A System

"Carrie! Why do you treat me like this? For the past three or four years, I have given you my heart and soul! I saved money and gave all my money to you, just to show you my sincerity! Why do you still abandon me and be with this middle-aged fat man?"
The boy grabbed the girl's hand and pointed at the fat old man in his forties aside, completely unable to control his emotions.
"Smack!"
Adrien Higgins looked at Carrie Archer in disbelief as she heartlessly slapped away his hand.
"Don't touch me!! Adrien Higgins, let me tell you! You are just an ordinary university classmate of mine! What you've spent on me, including your time and money, means nothing to me. My heart belongs to Mr. Irwin, the man standing in front of you! You'd better show some respect to me! Don't you dare lay a finger on me!"
Adrien looked at his girlfriend of three years, who had suddenly turned to another man, and tears welled up in Adrien's eyes.
"No!! You're lying to me!"
"I'm lying to you? Who do you think you are? Why should I lie to you? Look at you! You have no talent or money. You've already graduated from college but don't even have a stable job! And you want to pick up girls? You are a loser, a piece of trash. Stay away from me! Otherwise, my honey will make you stay away!"
Carrie did not hide her aversion and disgust toward Adrien at all.
"Honey, let's go. I don't really know this person. We were just classmates before. It's such a bummer that we encounter him. I feel like I'm contaminated by his poverty! You must buy me a new outfit later. I've already selected a Fendi suit that's especially suitable for my delicate figure!"
"Kid, let me tell you! My woman is not someone you can touch! You just touched her hand! You must pay me 3,000 dollars in! Give the money, or you will never see the sun rise again!"
Adrien looked at the two in disbelief, filled with anger. "I'll never see the sun rise again? What can you do to me? I've been an orphan since childhood, with no one to rely on! You wanna kill me? Come on!"
Adrien was driven mad by his wrath. Wayne Irwin came up to Adrien and slapped Adrien twice in the face. "Kid! I'll punch your lights out every time I see you!"
Adrien lowered his head in silence. The pain in his heart was far greater than the pain in his face.
"You loser. If it wasn't for the fact that you were popular and worked hard to earn money to spend on me when we were in college, did you really think I would have noticed someone like you without any background or ability? Hah, you'd better stay away from me in the future! Don't ever come to me again!" Carrie spoke with extreme disdain in Adrien's ear.
Her words were like a dagger digging into his heart.
Adrien watched as the two walked away side by side, the pain on his face bringing him a moment of clarity.
He worked so hard for three years just to see Carrie's smile. Now it seemed that Adrien was nothing but a stepping stone for her.
Carrie had ruthlessly trampled on Adrien's face and shattered all his hopes and dreams for the future.
The gloomy sky over Reburg was terrifying, and the invisible infrabar caused pedestrians to quicken their pace, afraid of being caught off guard by a sudden downpour.
Adrien walked alone on the street, watching as the storm approached with roaring winds, and the anger in his heart burst forth.
"You adulterers!! You two will die in misery!"
After a tirade of curses, people passing by Adrien thought Adrien was crazy, hurrying past Adrien.
Suddenly, the wind seemed to grow stronger and stronger, and Adrien could barely keep his eyes open.
After a final howling wind, he felt dizzy, and his head began to throb.
"Ding! The system is generating..."
"Ding! The system has successfully bound to host!"
Hearing that, Adrien quickly knew that he had won the biggest prize in the entire galaxy, an almighty system!
"Yes!" Adrien jumped up and down in excitement.
"Ding! Detected that the host's bank card only has a remaining balance of three dollars. Detected that the host was just humiliated by his ex-girlfriend. Triggering the first task: Wreak vengeance on her. Host, please go to the Fendi store in Reburg Center Mall and spend 40 thousand dollars immediately!"
Adrien was dumb upon hearing the system's words. He didn't even have four dollars, let alone 40 thousand dollars!
However, Adrien also knew the system wouldn't issue stupid tasks. It must have a second step! And he would have the money.
"Ding! The host's Reburg Bank card has received a payment of 40 thousand dollars!"
The system was indeed reliable! Adrien couldn't wait to see the expression on Carrie when she saw that Adrien didn't hesitate to spend 40 thousand dollars.
Suddenly, there was a loud rumble as heavy rain poured down on Reburg!
Adrien ran in the rain. He was not far away from the Reburg Center Mall, so he thought taking a taxi for such a short distance was a waste of money!
However, Adrien underestimated the power of the heavy rain. Within minutes, he was completely soaked and embarrassed when he arrived.
As soon as Adrien walked into Reburg Center Mall, the security guard at the entrance stopped Adrien.
"What? I got soaked, and I want to buy some clothes."
"Ahem, nothing, sir." The security guard thought Adrien was just seeking shelter from the rain and didn't expect Adrien to be there to shop.
After entering the mall, Adrien was shocked by its luxurious decor. A blast of cold air conditioning blew toward him, but it also ignited the flames of revenge in his heart!
Following the signs inside the mall, Adrien arrived at the Fendi store.

Chapter 2 Slap In The Face

Adrien stood wet outside the door of the Fendi store.
"Sir?"
"I just got soaked by the rain. So I want to buy some clothes that I can change into immediately. You know, it's uncomfortable to be all wet like this."
"I see. Please come in." The service assistant couldn't drive Adrien away since Adrien was a customer, even though Adrien didn't look well-dressed.
Adrien heard Carrie's voice from afar saying, "Honey, is this outfit nice?" Adrien looked over in the direction of her voice and coincidentally bumped into her face-to-face!
"Adrien Higgins! I told you not to follow me anymore! How dare you follow me here!" Carrie shouted.
Adrien turned his head as if he hadn't heard Carrie and continued to browse the clothes.
"How dare you play dumb with me?!" Carrie walked up to Adrien, but Adrien still ignored her as if she were invisible.
"Waitress, you better open your eyes wide so that people with only several dollars in their pockets won't come here and pick out clothes worth thousands of dollars!" Carrie pointed at Adrien and said arrogantly.
Adrien remained unmoved, continuing to choose suitable clothes for himself. It was not surprising that he was attracted to the clothes. He started working part-time in his sophomore year, and most of the money he earned was given to Carrie, only left some for daily use. To put it nicely, Adrien was a man who loved his wife. To put it bluntly, he was a lickspittle who was eventually cruelly abandoned by his lover!
"Sir, these clothes are all priced above 15 hundred dollars each. If you really don't plan to buy them, then please don't touch them. After all, we need to compensate for any damages." The service assistant couldn't bear to watch the scene any longer.
"Did you hear that, you beggar? Who gave you the courage to follow me to a store like this?! Honey, that poor loser is ruining our moods again!"
"I told you before! If I see you again, I'll hit you again! It seems like you have a short memory! You just got beaten up, and now you want some more, right?" Wayne walked toward Adrien with his fists clenched.
Adrien didn't even bother to look at Wayne since Wayne was just a sucker. Now that Adrien had a system, there was no need for Adrien to argue with Wayne. Adrien picked out two shirts and two pairs of pants and handed them to the service assistant. "Hold onto these four for me."
"You're just putting on airs. I know how much you have exactly!" Carrie sneered from the side, making the service assistant hesitant about Adrien's intention.
"If you know everything, do you know how much money I spent on you over the past three years?"
"That's because you were willing to spend it on me! You have no job, no background, and not even parents. You should be grateful that anyone wanted to be with you. I must be blind, for I actually wasted three years of my life with someone like you!"
"Carrie Archer, you spent nearly 30 thousand dollars of my money in the past three years."
"Three years? You were only giving me 700 dollars a month. How dare you calculate the total cost over three years!"
"You're right. You're absolutely right! So, where are the clothes your rich honey bought for you?" Adrien continued to browse the clothes without looking at Wayne or even Carrie.
Carrie immediately shook the clothes in her hand in front of Adrien.
"Look at this suit. It's customized and costs ten thousand dollars. It's what you spent on me in a year. With a honey like this, do I need someone like you?"
"Go pay for it now. Then put it on immediately and make your sugar daddy happy!"
"Adrien! Can't you speak properly and decently? He's my husband! My honey!"
"Did you get married? Calling an old man who's 20 or 30 years older than you like that, huh? His son must be older than you, right?" Adrien had cooled down at that moment and was being all sarcastic. He didn't seem like the person who was hesitant to compete with others without a system earlier. It surprised Carrie. Upon reflection, it was understandable that Adrien had worked different jobs and met different people in the past three years.
"You little brat, I believe you're looking for trouble!" Wayne, who was standing next to them, was furious when he heard Adrien's words. Although Wayne had a wife and child and was just playing around with Carrie, he couldn't bear to hear something so insulting said in public.
"Sir! If you're here to buy something, please watch your language. If not, I'll call security to escort you out!" The service assistant who held Adrien's clothes also spoke coldly to Adrien.
"Are you deaf? This woman has been insulting me since I entered. You didn't say anything just because she dressed nicely? I talked back to her, and now you want to kick me out? Remember who you are. You're just a service assistant. What makes you think you can yell at me?" Adrien's aura wasn't something that a recent graduate could be easily released but rather resembled those high-level rich people!
Another service assistant hurried over to stop her colleague, Janice, from arguing with the customer.
"Okay, okay, Sir. Let me serve you instead! Janice, you go serve this lady!"
"You poor loser, I'm watching you. Let's see if you can pay for your purchase!"
"Why don't you go pay for your own clothes first and then enjoy the show!"
"Honey, he's insulting me!" Carrie whined to Wayne.
"Waitress, the bill now!" Wayne took Carrie to handle the payment and then stood at the checkout counter, waiting to see Adrien make a fool of himself.
Adrien browsed for a while, and the service assistant behind him was holding a dozen or so clothes and was getting impatient, but she didn't show it.
"Let's go. I'll pay and change into these clothes. And I'll throw away what I'm wearing now."
When Adrien spoke, the service assistant hesitated and came to the checkout counter. Carrie rushed to Adrien's side and shouted, "I suggest you call the police. This person doesn't have any money. He's just here to play with you!"
The cashier nervously scanned the price tags and said, "Sir, you have thirteen items. That'll be 31 thousand dollars in total."
Adrien handed over his Reburg Bank card, and the cashier saw it was just an ordinary debit card. She immediately became stern and said, "Sir, you're disrupting public order by doing this! I will report you to the police."
"You're going to report me before you even swipe my card? Debit cards can't be swiped? Or is it that your little Fendi store's market value is higher than Reburg Bank's? Maybe your parent company has a higher market value than Reburg Bank, but you? Please swipe the card, waitress!"
"Hmph, what if your card doesn't work?" The cashier at the counter picked up Adrien's debit card and swiped it. Adrien calmly entered his password.
The receipt then came out!
Everyone around was dumbfounded!
"That's impossible! How could you have over 30 thousand dollars!" Carrie exclaimed in disbelief.
Ignoring her, Adrien took out a few clothes from his purchase and walked into the dressing room alone to change.
Soon, a handsome and decent young man appeared before everyone's eyes.
Adrien walked up to Carrie and whispered, "There's a beautiful bag in the back that suits your skin tone very well. Go take a look and let your sugar dad... Oh, no. Let your husband buy it for you."
Carrie was taken aback by Adrien's sudden change, but as soon as she heard his words, she couldn't help but want to see the bag. After all, Adrien had always had good taste, and she had really liked the few small gifts he had given her before, but things had changed since then.
"Honey, I'm going to take a look inside!"
"I'll go with you. And I'll buy whatever you like!"
Wayne's words greatly increased Carrie's confidence.
The two of them went to the bag section, and Carrie spotted the bag that Adrien had recommended to her at a glance.

Chapter 3 A Porsche From The System

"Miss, this bag costs 40 thousand dollars! You have great taste. The design and material of this bag are top-notch. Look at the color. It suits you very well. The designer of the clothes you just bought is the same as that of this bag. If you wear the clothes with this bag, you'll look even more youthful and beautiful." The service assistant's words made Carrie very happy.
"Honey, it's only 40 thousand dollars. It's not expensive! Buy it for me now!" Carrie spoke to Wayne in a demanding tone.
Wayne was very unhappy when he heard that. He didn't treat Carrie by keeping a mistress as some people did. He had only agreed to take her out for dinner and buy her some things because she had just graduated from college and had no job or savings. When he heard Carrie telling him that her ex-boyfriend had been harassing her, he felt protective of her. He never expected her to be so insatiable and demanding! And he was furious!
Adrien calculated that he still needed to spend about 9 thousand dollars to complete his mission, so he continued to browse around and picked up two pairs of shoes. As Adrien was paying, he suddenly heard a quarrel from the bag section. Adrien smirked triumphantly.
"You piece of trash! Who do you think you are? How dare you ask me to buy such an expensive bag! I've already done you a favor by buying you this dress! You really have no shame!" Then came the sound of a slap!
Hearing the sound of the slap, Adrien knew that it was definitely much harsher than the two slaps he had received earlier. But he was determined to get revenge for those two slaps in the future!
"I'll use this card to pay!" Adrien handed over the debit card he had just used to make the payment.
"Yes, Sir! We're sorry for offending you earlier. Please forgive us!"
Adrien had just finished paying when Wayne came to the checkout counter with the clothes he had bought for Carrie.
"Return this dress for me right now! Process it immediately!"
"Honey, please don't do that! I don't want that bag anymore! Don't return my dress!" Adrien watched the drama show with great satisfaction.
"You whore! You think I'm a cash cow, huh? Do you think I'm like that stupid boy? I just wanted to play with you! Remember that!"
"Honey! I don't want that bag anymore! I'm sorry!" Carrie immediately took on a pitiful and regretful attitude.
Adrien saw how cheap the person he used to like had become and lost his desire for revenge.
As Adrien walked past Carrie with his clothes, he muttered quietly, "How pathetic!"
Carrie looked at Adrien's back with hatred, but more than that, she felt regret!
As Adrien walked out of the Fendi store, he heard the sound he had been waiting for in his mind.
"Ding! The host has completed the face-slapping mission and received a cash reward of three thousand dollars. The money has been deposited to your account in real-time!"
"System, is the money legal?"
Adrien asked nervously.
"Please rest assured, Host. All money, assets, task rewards, technology distribution, and lottery draws by the system are traceable and completely legal. Please feel free to use them!"
The system's words reassured Adrien, who then went to a restaurant to have a nice meal as a celebration!
As Adrien walked out of the restaurant after finishing his meal, he saw a middle-aged man who seemed to be feeling unwell suddenly falling to the ground. The people and security guards around the middle-aged man immediately rushed over.
"Are you okay? Wake up!" The security guard was trying to wake the middle-aged man up.
Adrien squeezed in and saw what had happened. He had previously worked part-time helping people as a guide and orientation counselor at the hospital and had been trained in professional cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
"Everyone, please step back and keep the air flowing!" Adrien instructed, pointing to the security guard. "Call an ambulance immediately!"
Adrien shouted at the middle-aged man and began to perform professional chest compressions and artificial respiration on the man when he saw that there was no response.
Not long after, the middle-aged man suddenly regained consciousness!
The people around breathed a sigh of relief.
"Are you okay, sir?" Adrien asked.
"What happened just now?" the middle-aged man asked.
"You passed out. This young man saved you. I've already called 911, and the ambulance will be here soon. I suggest you go to the hospital to get checked out!" the security guard explained.
"Oh! Thank you very much, young man! I have had heart trouble since birth. I felt suffocated just now, and then I lost consciousness!"
"Do you have any medication with you, sir?" Adrien asked with concern.
"I forgot to bring it. I tend to forget things easily since I am now getting old! What's your name, young man? I need to repay you!" The man tried to stand up while reaching for his pocket.
"Sir, you'd better sit down. After a heart attack, you shouldn't move around casually, especially not stand up suddenly while sitting. I don't need you to repay me. I was just passing by. Wait for the ambulance here. I've got things to do, so I'm leaving now!"
Adrien said and left with his things. The man watched Adrien's back and sighed that there were many good people in the world.
"Mr. Keller! What happened to you?"
Suddenly, two people ran over from a distance and went to the middle-aged man's side. The security guard described what had happened, and one of them went to the surveillance room to check the situation while the other stayed with the middle-aged man.
Adrien arrived at the entrance of Reburg Center Mall. The security guard took a look at Adrien and suddenly remembered that Adrien was that wet young man. Adrien looked so different now. Although Adrien's hair was still a bit messy, Adrien had the appearance of a successful young man.
"Ding! The Host has just rescued someone enthusiastically and received an additional reward from the system! The host is awarded a Porsche roadster. Please check your car!"
After System finished speaking, Adrien felt something inexplicably appear in his pocket.
He put his hand into his pocket and pulled out the key with the Porsche logo on it, feeling excited.
"System, where's the car? I got my driver's license a long time ago, and I worked as a driver for six months! But I never had a car to drive!"
"The car is located in parking space A008 on the B3 floor of Reburg Center Mall, Host!"
Adrien held the car key in his right hand and his newly bought clothes from Fendi in his left hand, humming a song all the way to the B3 floor of the underground parking lot.
Unexpectedly, he ran into Carrie and Wayne again. One was crying and begging for forgiveness, and the other was shouting loudly!
When Carrie was pleading with Wayne, she suddenly saw Adrien walking toward the Porsche roadster on the opposite side.
"Adrien! You liar! You tricked me!" Carrie shouted in Adrien's direction.
Adrien completely ignored Carrie. Such a woman was not worth his continued infatuation. He would move on from the past three years. With the system now, he was determined to become the richest man in the universe. Carrie was nothing to him now!
Adrien composed himself and stood in front of his red Porsche roadster. It was a supercar, but he didn't know the model. Then, he finally laughed out loud, "Let me see you, my dear honey! Muah!" Adrien leaned over and kissed the car twice!
People passing by took a look and thought that Adrien was crazy. The car was good, and even the license plate was unique. The young man was also dressed well, but was it necessary to act like that toward a car? Adrien acted like he was a fetishist.

Chapter 4 Almighty System

Adrien didn't care how others looked at him. He circled around the Porsche roadster and loved the red color. He looked at the license plate number, which was a unique number, RE12345.
"What an awesome license plate number!" Adrien laughed and took out the key and pressed it lightly. The car lights flashed twice, and he quickly sat in the driver's seat.
"Wow, I'm also a car owner now!" Until now, Adrien seemed to still be in a dream. Everything came too suddenly!
"System! Are you really real?"
"Of course."
"Blessing from heaven!" Adrien laughed excitedly.
He inserted the key, turned it on, and started the car! Under Adrien's driving, the Porsche roadster rushed out with a swoosh.
Driving on the streets of Reburg, Adrien felt for the first time that life could be beautiful.
"Adrien grew up in an orphanage. When he realized he was an orphan, he became hopeless about the future. So even though he was bullied and insulted since childhood, he chose to endure it until he met the first girl who approached him actively in college, Carrie, but it turned out like that.
"
"Now, I, Adrien Higgins, am no longer the person I was! I must completely change myself!"
After driving around for a while, Adrien returned home and parked his car downstairs. When he turned around and saw his old shabby rental apartment, it formed a sharp contrast with the bright red Porsche supercar.
Back at home, he took a shower and hung up his newly bought clothes. Then he fell into a deep sleep.
Adrien slept until the evening and ordered himself a super seafood platter that he had never dared to order before, enjoying it while communicating with the system.
"System, what functions do you have? Can you tell me in detail?"
"Host, the system is an almighty system with many functions. Host, close your eyes and feel the control panel in your mind."
Following the system's instructions, Adrien closed his eyes. Then a set of very advanced-looking control panel appeared in his mind. In the clear picture, eight circular patterns revolved around the largest pattern in the center.
Among them, the largest circular logo had the word "Level" written on it, and there was also a row of small numbers below the level, which currently read 112/20000.
The eight circular keys around it were marked with the words "Blessing," "Raffles," "Skills," "Clock in," "Predictions," "Swap," "Curse," and "Technologies." However, now only the Predictions key was lit, and the other colorful keys were basically dim. In the upper right corner of the control area, there was a Square Exit key, and in the lower left corner was a Self-protection function key!
"System, I see that some of the keys are dim, meaning they are not activated. What does that mean? And what does the Level key in the middle mean?"
"The Level key means that as the host's expenses increase, the system level gradually increases from level 1, and with each upgrade, the other keys around the system will be activated. After activation, the system will become more powerful and perfect. Currently, the host is at level 1, and the EXP is 112/20000. When the host's EXP accumulates to 20,000, the system will enter an upgrade."
"I see! This system is simply perfect!" Adrien looked at the eight keys around again and silently clicked on the Predictions key!
"Ding! The host has activated the Predictions key, and the result will be refreshed soon!"
This was Adrien's first time using the system function key, so he was full of expectations!
"Ding! On March 22, 2034, the winning numbers for the national welfare lottery will be 03, 06, 15, 21, 23, 32, and 11, with a total bonus of 160 million dollars, the largest jackpot in history! Please make good use of it, Host!"
"What the heck?! The system actually gave me the winning numbers, with a bonus of 160 million dollars! I have to calculate..."
"Ding! The system version is too low. It is recommended that the host upgrade immediately tomorrow."
"Understood, System!"
Adrien was so excited that he almost didn't sleep all night. He barely fell asleep around 3 o'clock in the morning.
He slept until noon the next day, cleaned him up, put on the Fendi clothes he bought the day before, and planned to go out to buy the lottery ticket first and quickly spend money to upgrade the system!
As soon as he walked downstairs, he suddenly found that there were many people around his red Porsche roadster in front. Adrien was puzzled. Why were so many people surrounding his car?
Before he got close, he heard a woman say, "Your child drew on someone's car like this. Can't you properly teach your child?!"
"I... Misael! Look at what you've done!"
Hearing that, Adrien felt a thump in his heart. He had just gotten the Porsche roadster yesterday, and he cherished it like a treasure. Did the mischievous child graffiti on it?
He hurried over, squeezed into the crowd, and was dumbfounded on the spot!
"Damn it! My car!!"
The side door of the Porsche roadster was covered with flowers, clouds, and trees drawn by the child named Misael using water-based pens.
"The owner of the car is here!" someone said.
"Sir!! Is this your car?" a woman asked nervously.
"It's mine, and why does it look like this now?" Adrien was unhappy.
"I'm sorry, I'm really sorry! My child is too young. I didn't watch him carefully, and he drew on your car! How much will it cost to repair it? We'll compensate you!" the woman said nervously.
"This car costs over one hundred thousand dollars. You might not be able to afford it even if you sell your house!" A man who was watching the commotion remarked.
"What?! It's that expensive?!" The woman was stunned upon hearing that.
"Yeah, it's a Porsche roadster! It's rare to see it on the road. But why did you park such a nice car here?"
The woman was stunned again. Then she reached out and grabbed her child, pinched his neck tightly, and pressed hard. The child fell to his knees in front of Adrien and started crying loudly out of fear.
Adrien was speechless. He looked at the child in front of him. Misael was probably three or four years old. And the fact that the mother was still waiting there without running away showed that she had enough sense of responsibility. Adrien was not an overbearing person. After seeing that scene, he felt much less angry.
"What are you doing? Even if your child made a mistake, you can't make him kneel in front of me!"
"Waahh!! Mommy, please don't hit me anymore!" Misael cried miserably as the woman gave him a series of slaps on his buttocks.

Chapter 5 Sudden Raffle

"Waahh!! Mommy, please don't hit me anymore!" Misael cried miserably as the woman gave him a series of slaps on his buttocks.
"How could you?! Do you know how big of a problem you've caused? This car is so expensive. Why can't you be more responsible!" The woman's screams scared Misael into silence and tears.
"I'm really sorry, sir. How should we compensate you? It's my fault. I was negligent with my child. I'm really sorry!" The woman apologized while also being frightened.
Adrien felt helpless. Everyone who lived there was poor. How could he force a poor person to sell their house to pay for his car's repair costs? That would be like pushing someone to death.
Adrien asked in his mind, "System, does this car have insurance?"
"All the things that the system gives to the host are complete sets. The insurance is of the highest level!"
Adrien walked over to Misael, helped him up, and said, "Misael, your parents work hard to raise you. You can't just destroy other people's property. Do you understand?"
"I understand now. Sir, I'm sorry!" Misael apologized tearfully to Adrien.
"If you're still not satisfied, you can beat Misael up, but don't kill him!" the woman said with a hint of sorrow.
"What are you talking about? The child made a mistake, so teach him a lesson, and that's enough. As long as he remembers and doesn't make the same mistake again in the future, it will be fine. What's the point of hitting him? Even if you hit him, he might not learn anything!"
"Right, you're right. How much should I give you?"
Adrien looked at the drawings on the car and then at the pen in Misael's hand.
"Misael, you drew on my car and ruined it. As punishment, I will use this pen in your hand to draw on your face the blue sky and white clouds that you drew on my car. Do you agree?" Adrien said gently.
Misael looked confused and turned to his mother for guidance.
The woman repeatedly nodded her head, and then Misael handed the pen to Adrien. Adrien took the pen and started drawing on Misael's face.
After a while, Misael's face was covered with messy drawings, which made everyone around them laugh. Misael wanted to see himself, so Adrien picked Misael up and let Misael see himself from the car window.
"It looks really ugly!"
"So you can't do this again in the future, okay?"
"Yes. I'll be good from now on!"
"Good. Now go home with your mom." Adrien's words surprised the woman and the people watching.
"You're just letting her go like that when they did this to your car?" A passerby asked.
"The child made a mistake, and I have punished him. I don't know how much it will cost to repair my car, but I can't make things difficult for a mother. This is enough. Don't surround us anymore. I have things to do and need to leave!"
"You... you're such a good person! Thank you!" The woman and Misael bowed to Adrien, who waved his hand and drove away.
As Adrien left the residential area, he looked at the damage to his car again and felt heartbroken. He took out his phone and called the dealership. After learning that it could be repaired, he made an appointment at three o'clock in the afternoon and then went to look for the lottery store!
On the way, Adrien searched for the store. Suddenly, the system notification sound popped up again in his mind!
"Ding, the host is considerate in handling matters and has won one Raffle! Would the host like to Raffle now?"
Hearing the system's words, Adrien felt much more psychologically balanced!
"Not now! Later!"
The most important thing now was not the Raffle or repairing the car but buying lottery tickets and upgrading the system at the same time!
Adrien arrived at a lottery store on Reburg Central Avenue. He handed over a set of numbers that he had written down.
"Sir, I want the number with a two hundred times multiplier! Take a good look, and don't get the wrong numbers!"
"Two hundred times? Young man, you're really confident," the man chuckled and shook his head, not believing that Adrien could win.
"I'm really lucky lately!" Adrien said. After getting the lottery ticket, he put it in his phone case and left!
Once outside the lottery store, Adrien took out the lottery ticket and looked at it carefully for a long time. He still couldn't figure out what was so special about his ticket. He then glanced at his phone, which he had bought second-hand four years ago when he just started college. The camera sucked. It was time to upgrade!
Adrien stepped on the gas pedal and arrived at a nearby shopping mall. He walked into a phone store.
"Hello, sir. What would you like to see?"
"I want to buy a new phone. What are the prices?"
"They range from over nine hundred dollars to more than 17 hundred dollars."
"Give me the one that costs 17 hundred dollars, and select a tablet for me. Together, they should be less than 3,000 dollars!"
"Okay, sir. Please wait a moment."
Shortly after, Adrien put the lottery ticket worth 160 million dollars in his newly purchased phone case. He checked his account balance, which was still more than 110 dollars. He then went to the car store.
Adrien was not familiar with the car store. He just parked his car outside and made a phone call. Then, a customer service representative came to take his car key. Before leaving, Adrien asked about the repair cost, but the other party said it was covered by insurance, so Adrien didn't need to pay anything. They would contact him when the car was fixed.
Adrien took his new phone and tablet and returned to his house in the taxi. Suddenly, his phone rang, and Adrien was not used to it!
"Hello?"
"Hey, Adrien! What have you been up to lately?" It was Kamron Frost, Adrien's college buddy.
"I haven't been doing much these days. Just staying at home."
"Are you working today? If you're free, come out for dinner tonight! Let's go to that restaurant outside our college! I just got paid today, so I'll treat our dorm mates to a meal! You have to come! It's been a long time since the four of us got together!" Kamron said.
"No problem! What time?" asked Adrien.
"6:30 pm. See you tonight!" replied Kamron.
"After hanging up the phone, Adrien felt very happy. During his four years of college, besides his three roommates who never looked down on him and always helped him, he had almost no other friends. Adrien always kept the friendship in mind, and if he ever became successful in the future, he would definitely help his three buddies out!
"
"System! You mentioned that there was one chance for a Raffle before! What is that?" Adrien asked.
"The host handles things very tactfully and has received an extra Raffle from the system as a reward. Would the host like to Raffle now?" the system replied.

Chapter 1
I had thought it would be the most romantic day ever. There were two pieces of good news to celebrate today: my 3rd wedding anniversary and the fact that I'd just gotten a promotion.
I walk eagerly to the man I love, stretching onto my toes to kiss Ryan. But he ducks, pushing something into my arms.
When I unwrapped it, my whole body froze.
A divorce document.
“That's what I want. “ Ryan said coldly. His arms crossed over his chest.” Honestly, I'm sick and tired of this. You're not taking care of our home. ”
It took me a minute to comprehend the current situation.” It wasn't April Fool's Day. ”
Exasperated, Ryan rolls his angry eyes at me and gestures to the room around us. “ Do you know what it’s like to walk into a room with cat hair everywhere and a carpet that hasn’t been cleaned in months? ”
My eyes widen, my head pulling back to look at my husband. “Let me remind you that I make twice as much as you do and that I am the one who pays for the cleaners. Yet, I distinctly remember conversing with you a long time ago where we agreed to take turns dividing our workload!”
The counter-argument makes Ryan grunt, throwing his head back as he stares at the ceiling. “I earn money too, Esme!” He snaps at me.
“Then what’s the problem here?”
“The problem? Why don’t I have a housewife? You can’t even be bothered to bring me a child to raise!”
“Me? You do realize I want to have this baby, too, right? You’re the one who refuses to go with me to the hospital! Maybe if you were a bit more active—”
Ryan interrupts me with a laugh that silences me.
“You know what I’m talking about,” He spits, seemingly implying that I’m a liar. “You’re having an affair with your boss; don’t deny it!”
Mr. Anderson? Derek Anderson? The confusion seems to proliferate, and the facial expressions that take over my face feel like a dream.
The only thing that is true about my boss is that he’s a dashing divorced man. I’m dazed at the idea my husband accuses me of sneaking behind his back.
“I can absolutely assure you, Ryan, that there never has and never will be anything regarding my boss! I am his subordinate, and there’s nothing left to discuss about Mr. Anderson!”
His arms cross over his chest again, huffing. “You’re so delusional that your work has given you everything you desire when, in fact, it is your boss.”
“Fine. You want this divorce and to live in your fantasy world where I’m the villain? I’ll sign your freaking divorce papers, but not right now. For now, I’m going to find a competent lawyer to help me properly divide my property from you.”
I start rushing toward the front door, needing to escape this house, this man, this absurdity.
But I hear Ryan chasing me down the hall. “Esme! Quit stalling for more time or to conjure up new lies. If you have a clean conscience, then you should sign the papers today.”
He grabs my arm and whirls me around, and for the first time since I met Ryan, I don’t recognize the man. His eyes are dark, his skin ice cold as his fingers wrap around my upper arm, and his voice full of disgust.
I shake my head, ripping my arm from his grasp, slap my husband in the face, and I leave the house with papers in hand and my heart bleeding on the floor in front of the man.
Happy anniversary to me.
“I’m going to have to murder the scum!”
My best friends, Annie and Lily, sit at the bar on either side of me. Ransom’s Tavern is our favorite place to drown our sorrows, and Lily is basically ready to go all Jeffery Dahmer on Ryan.
“And on your anniversary of all days! Who asks for a divorce on the day two people get married? He better be ready for me because I’m going to end his entire life with one freaking punch to the face!”
I can’t help but laugh at Lily as she puts up her fists like she’s preparing for battle. Her nose scrunches up, and her eyebrows hide behind her brown bangs.
“Calm yourself,” Annie instructs our friend.
“Calm? How can you be calm? He’s just told our best friend that she’s only where she is in her career because she’s been sleeping with her boss! Do you know how incredibly misogynistic and disgusting that is?”
“Talk louder; I don’t think the entire block heard you,” I reply as I take a drink. This is the last thing I need. I rub my left temple, my curly blonde hair quickly becoming tangled in my fingers.
“Moving on!” Annie instructs, waving her perfectly manicured hand at Lily. Then, touching my hand on the sticky bar, Annie states seriously, “Esme, if I were you, I’d go to your boss’ house and sleep with him. Now.”
I roll my eyes as I give the two women a sad smile. “Come on, my boss isn’t like you, guys. He’s a family man. He’s got a lot of responsibilities on his plate.”
“Uh, isn’t your boss single now?” Lily questions.
I shrug, taking another sip of my watery beer. “He’s got two daughters, and from what I’ve heard, he takes care of them independently.”
“Aka, he’s single and maybe ready to mingle?” Annie teases, biting her bottom lip at her joke.
I nudge my shoulder against hers, unable to keep a laugh from rising out of me. “Stop it!”
I wouldn’t be shocked if Anderson is single, especially since he never works overtime. He always leaves as soon as the clock strikes five like Cinderella leaving the ball at midnight.
But as I sit here, I start to wonder if the booze has already saturated my mind. Because suddenly, Anderson is all I’m able to think about.
Who would it hurt if I were to maybe…text him? Ryan would be furious, absolutely floored at my gall. But my anger, my desire to hurt the man who I’d married three years ago, fuels my rage.
“I’m going to text him,” I tell the girls, pulling out my phone. I’m going to tell him exactly where I am right now and use this to relieve some of the anger.
Getting back at Ryan for his selfish and pathetic behavior? Better than giving him a swift kick in his special little place.
“No way. Prove it!” Annie smirks, looking down at my phone lying on the bar.
I pick up the phone, typing in Anderson’s name in my messages. I’ll send him my address as if supposedly informing a friend of my whereabouts. Then, after about a minute, I’ll just tell him I’d sent the message to the wrong person.
No harm, no foul.
Besides, it’s already 8:45. It must be parenting time for Anderson.
I type in the address to Ransom’s Tavern and hit send. I put down the phone, my friends laughing and shoving me with disbelief.
To my surprise, my phone buzzes back immediately with a reply.
“Five minutes.”

Chapter 2
“No way, no way!” Annie squeals as she grabs my phone from my hands. Her pale blue eyes sparkle with mischief. “Lily, he’s coming!”
“Shut up!” Lily shouts, reaching across me to take my phone next, pushing a piece of her short brown hair away from her face.
“This is absolutely crazy. I can’t even believe it! Five minutes? That’s so fast!” Annie cries, her arm catapulting back for the phone.
“Oh my God, I’m so excited, I can’t wait to see what he looks like!” Lily adds, jumping in her bar seat with excitement.
The two of them are growing louder by the second, and now I’m starting to get a headache and regret my message.
“Didn’t you just point out that he’s got two daughters? It’s a school night. He’s probably spending time with the kids,” Lily points out as Annie re-reads the texts for the tenth time.
“What do you think this means?” Annie asks, still staring at my phone.
“Maybe he’ll bring them along,” Lily gushes.
I’m too stunned to say anything. Did I really do this to myself? I can’t even believe it!
As if a magic wand is waved over my head, I feel the drunkenness clears up instantly, and now I’m sweating from every possible place I can think of.
“He…he must have thought I was contacting him for a work-related matter,” I find myself stammering to the girls. “He’s incredibly dedicated.”
Annie shakes her head. “Except this is outside of work hours, honey. Besides, he knows this is a pub, yet here he is, rushing over like your knight in shining armor!”
She and Lily scream again, their bodies jumping up and down in the bar seats as they shake their arms in the air.
Well, if the drunkenness has left, then bring on the hangover because I am far too sober for this.
I’m honestly speechless now. My friends must be overthinking things, surely. I mean, Anderson is just so professional in the office. He cares for his subordinates, and I know that.
Besides, I’ve never messaged him outside of the working hours in the past, so that must have made him inclined to believe it must be something serious.
Even if that’s not the case, I can’t help but continue panicking in my head over the fact Anderson will be here soon.
As the end of the five minutes approaches, Lily and Annie decide to step aside to let me handle this situation on my own. They sit at a table in the back of the bar, watching me like I’m their newest form of entertainment.
I better come up with a perfect lie. I’m starting to sweat and growing more nervous by the second for Anderson to show up. Maybe something about how work has been a struggle, or I’ve had a few difficult clients?
As the thoughts run through my head, they’re quickly sent away when Anderson walks into the bar in an elegant, perfectly tailored suit. His eyes search for me before landing on the bar, and he smiles gently.
Standing at what I can imagine to be over six feet tall, Derek Anderson is a white yet tanned man in his late thirties with dark brown hair on his head. He has his usual dark smudges under his eyes, which match his exhaustion. He’s also just about one of the most good-looking men I’ve ever seen.
I quickly scramble to my feet once he enters, realizing I have absolutely no idea what I must look like. A wreck, probably, considering I just got dumped by my own husband. Is my hair okay? What about my makeup?
Oh man, what about my breath?
Anderson approaches, keeping his smile spread out on his face. I take a deep breath, and tell myself to calm down.
“Congratulations on your promotion, Esme,” Anderson says once he’s closed the distance. He looks really good tonight.
“T-Thank you,” I stutter out, trying to keep my composure. “I’m looking forward to taking on the new responsibilities.”
We both sit at the bar together, still keeping one another in our line of sight.
I do put a lot of time into my job, and it is genuinely rewarding and fulfilling. I mean, the years I’ve put into it have given me such a rush of pride. But thinking of Ryan’s complaints scratches at the surface of my skin.
“I brought you a gift to celebrate,” Anderson states, holding out a small bag for me to take from him.
Surprised, I reached out for the bag. What could he have possibly grabbed for me in the five minutes it took for him to arrive?
“Thank you, Mr. Anderson, that’s very kind of you.”
He gestures to the bag. “Why don’t you open it?”
I look down at the bag, feeling awkward about opening his gift right here, but do as he asks.
I can’t contain my absolute shock when I pull the gift out of the bag. A jewelry box?
I slowly open the box, seeing a beautiful necklace inside. My jaw drops.
“W-w-what? How did you—?”
Anderson gives me a sheepish smile, nodding at the box. “I happened to notice your phone’s wallpaper recently, and…” He rubs the back of his neck. “I hope that it wasn’t too personal.”
I can’t hide my stunned expression. This is so thoughtful of Anderson, and I raise my eyes to his. How do I even thank him for this?
The necklace, a beautiful silver chain with a dark blue heart wrapped around it, was supposed to be a gift hint for Ryan to find. I picked it out because I knew how perfect it would match my own dark blue eyes.
I’ve been eyeing this for weeks and was so, so hopeful he would figure out my desire to own it.
I’m so confused because this is like my dream wedding anniversary! Though, in reality, it’s all a mess—yet here I stand with my own boss, my eyes wide and mouth agape as I hold onto the beautiful jewelry.
This is Anderson handing over this gift, though. Not my own husband.
“So, what’s the matter?”
“I’m getting a divorce!” I blurt out without a thought.
My boss’s expression morphs, and he gives off a strange expression. “Sorry?” He questions.
At this very moment, I notice something pink on the corner of Anderson’s suit. Is that…Peppa Pig? A sticker?
God, what the heck am I doing? This is my boss! He’s a mature man with children and professional conduct. A full-fledged, single father with no need for some random employee to take up his incredibly important time.
I take one deep breath, then another. Calm down a second. This day has been such a whirlwind that I must have gotten swept up in the kind gesture from Anderson.
My nerves are growing, and I feel inexplicably and desperately wanting to escape this incredibly awkward situation. My personal life doesn’t need to be brought up in front of Anderson, so what am I doing talking to him like we’re old friends catching up?
Out of professionalism, it’s imperative that my personal matters are handled privately and have nothing to do with him. What am I even doing calling him to the bar and divulging that I’m leaving Ryan behind?
Abruptly, I make my voice sound natural, though it doesn’t feel as such. “What I meant to say was,” I start, another breath to calm myself. “I’d like to request time off.”
Anderson raises his left eyebrow.
I nearly cough. “I need to handle the…related paperwork, if that’s okay, sir?”
It feels like a bowling ball has landed on my chest as I watch his expression go unchanging. God, of all the times, to sound like a complete bumbling mess, it has to be in front of my boss.

Chapter 3
“Is that all?” Anderson asks after the silence becomes too stuffy. He’s frowning slightly, and I notice his posture slightly worsen.
In my head, I’m thinking, What else? After all, when he arrived, he had no clue about my fight with Ryan. Does he even know today was our anniversary?
For some reason, as I continue to stare at the man, I feel a sense of something. Is it…disappointment? Why?
Instead of probing him with more questions, I nod my head up at the tall man. His eyes, dark and honestly somewhat mysterious, crash against my skin like a hot laser burning into me.
“That’s all, yes,” I finally reply.
I look at Anderson, and then my eyes drift over to Annie and Lily in the corner of the bar. They’re watching so intensely you’d think they've never seen two people interact before. I feel severe discomfort with their daggers.
“Very well,” Anderson says, straightening his suit jacket. “Your time off is approved. If there is anything else I can do for you, please let me know.”
“Thank you,” I say to him, wanting to give a smile but struggling to let myself give one away. He’s a kind man, and I appreciate his understanding.
“Of course. Though, I have one more question, Esme.”
I turn my head to the side at the statement.
“Are you here alone tonight?” Anderson’s voice seems to warble a bit, and it throws me off for a moment. Did it matter if I’m here by myself or not?
Not wanting to lie but still feeling a bit nervous, I nod my head again. “Yes, I am.”
Anderson stands back up to depart, wiping something off of his jacket. As he does this, a waiter comes up to me and deposits a drink in front of me.
“Oh, no, I didn’t order—” I start to say, unsure where this mystery drink came from.
“Charge it double and put it on my tab,” Anderson deadpans, handing over his card to the waiter, who quickly swipes it through and gives it back.
“Sir, I don’t think—”
Before I can speak, Anderson returns the card to his pocket. “Goodnight, Esme. I hope your paperwork is sorted out shortly.”
“But sir, you don’t have to—” I’m sputtering, but he holds up his hand to stop my sentence again.
“Enjoy your night.”
Anderson then walks out of the bar alone, and I can’t help but stare in disbelief at the man as he disappears behind the walls. What the heck just happened?
That was all so weird, and I’m struggling to find any words to say now that I’ve been left alone at the bar.
It takes another few seconds, but Annie and Lily come rushing over with bright eyes. I can tell the two are ready to start interrogating me for what happened between us, but in truth, I don’t have any words for them.
Instead, all I can do is gesture with my hands at what is before me. The necklace, the drink, and my confusion are all present.
I want to tell them I don’t know what happened, but I think my face is saying that enough. Because I don’t know anything. This was all just…random?
Lily, snickering to herself, mimics Anderson under her breath with her large smile. “I’ll pay double.”
“What did you say to him?” Annie pushes, and I just shrug.
“Oh, come on! He walks in here and hands you some fancy jewelry and then hands over his card without even knowing what you’re drinking. That was him clearly flirting!” Lily says dreamily.
“Hardly,” my voice croaks.
“How many men would come into this bar and do the exact same thing, though, Esme?” Annie insists. “That man just swept you off your feet!”
I look at the door where Anderson exited, wanting to ask him what is going through his head. But that’s the issue. Now he’s left again, and I’m left wondering what this day has turned into.
A freaking fiasco, for sure.
Later, after finally getting Lily and Annie to let me leave the bar and return home, I climb into my empty bed.
Alone for the first time in years, I feel helpless over my foreseeable future. It’s hard to judge whether things will be good or not with Ryan already pushing and shoving his way out the door.
What am I supposed to do about all of this? Today should have been perfect. Ryan could have swept me off my feet, and we could have had a romantic dinner together, shared gifts and kisses and laughter, and enjoyed ourselves. Instead, here I am, holding back tears against my pillow.
I got a promotion, and on my wedding anniversary at the age of 30, I’m about to lose my marriage. What’s worse is I’m still childless, which causes my heart to strain. I don’t want that label. I don’t want that nightmare.
Now, I’m going to be the divorced single woman everywhere I try to go.
Or, maybe, a single, divorced career woman.
Though, that seems to be even more stressful than the divorced woman label.
I shake my head out on the pillow, throwing my face into the sheet. This is all happening so bloody fast that I’m unsure what else to do.
And on top of everything bad that’s happened today, I can’t stop replaying Anderson’s facial expressions and kindness toward me. He’s a genuinely kind individual, so having him attempt to comfort me was sympathetic.
I can’t imagine Ryan doing the same for me, even if we are still married. His compassionate side has never been his strong suit.
Then again, maybe I’ve just been wearing rose-tinted glasses the whole time, and he was never a good husband to begin with. I guess it’s possible to be lost in a world of love.
Grunting and rolling over to get out of bed, I realize that sleep shall continue to evade unless I do something about it.
Grabbing my wallet and a light jacket to cover my pajamas, I finally exit my place, trudging downstairs and out into the world to fix this incredibly horrid headache and insomnia.
Around the corner from my place is a 24-hour convenience store. Maybe the clinic will have the meds I’m looking for. Regardless, I’m so over this day, and I just want to sleep and have it be tomorrow.
The best way forward is through, after all.
I shuffle into the clinic, making my way to the medication section. I tend to pick up whatever the strongest medications happen to be on the shelf.
At this rate, they’re going to need to make a simple medication to calm my anxiety, too.
Maybe I should go back to the doctor. My insomnia hasn’t really corrupted my sleep and made me this tired in years. But clearly, I’ll be struggling for the foreseeable future.
I shuffle into the next aisle to grab a large bottle of water to take with my meds. As I get to the front of the store to pay for my supplies, I hear a voice I recognize.
“Is this the right one, you think?” He asks another person nearby.
I stretch my neck, seeing the one person I’m desperately trying not to think about.
I see the short haired blonde first, and I’m surprised to see Ryan standing in the aisle just to the left of me. Then, I hear a second voice.
“Maybe we get this one,” she replies.
I narrow my eyes, and as I thank the man at the counter, I walk over to the two people.
It’s Ryan alright, but the person he’s with?
My cousin, Melinda. With her picture-perfect beauty and her short black hair pulled into a pathetic excuse for a ponytail, I look at the two of them down the aisle.
And the object they’re talking about is a freaking test stick?

Chapter 4
“You really had to do this to me, didn’t you?” Melinda complains as they pick up another stick to examine. “You couldn’t have used protection before you got the divorce?”
“Babe, it’s going to be fine because we’re going to be divorced soon! Esme—that freaking foolish woman—she’s got no idea about us! Besides, she’s got significantly more savings than I do, and soon, we’re going to inherit a fortune!”
“You better hope so, dummy,” Melinda grunts as she turns the pink box over in her hands. “This is stressing me out.”
“Look, we’ll inherit the money, we’ll be rich, and you and I will be together. You should get knocked up immediately, unlike Esme. She can’t even have kids!”
I feel my heart turn cold, my skin burns, and my anger blinds me. This cheater! This whole time, I thought our main issue was over not having children!
My fingers strain around the bottles I hold, and a million different things cross my mind to screech at these two people; people I trusted!
This entire marriage has never hindered kids; it’s only ever been for Ryan to divorce me and take my money! That spineless, pathetic scum.
“Melinda! What the heck?” I screech at the two, giving away my position. “I can’t believe you got into bed with him!”
The two of them turn to look at me, eyebrows raised, and, at least in my cousin’s face, a slight hint of fear.
“What are you doing here?” Ryan demands.
“Hearing you plan your new life.” I glower at my soon-to-be ex-husband. “You really think I’m this foolish?”
“Oh no, I don’t think it, I know it!” Ryan retorts back.
I look straight at my cousin, my eyes falling into slits as I speak the truth. “I don’t have children. No. But maybe that’s because this man’s got useless seeds.”
I jab a finger in Ryan’s direction. “I won’t let you parasites take a single penny from me! This is freaking war.”
I stomp out of the pharmacy with a new purpose and officially wide awake. I’m not letting this ship go down. Just the opposite: I’m going to ruin their lives.
I’m getting a lawyer, gathering all the evidence, and I’m taking them down every peg possible.
But first, I need to move out of this place. The thought of Ryan and Melinda doing it in my bed makes me want to vomit.
I spend the night putting together what I can find, refusing to let sleep take me away from my work.
Once the sun comes up, I start chugging coffee, heading into the office to ask if any of my colleagues know anything about nearby rental options.
I let myself get lost in my job and rental searches, frantic as I let the day whiz by me. It’s not until I stop for a moment in the daze of anger and work that I realize two things:
The first one is that I told Anderson I needed time off, and I still came into the office today.
The second one is that it’s almost five, and I have two messages from my boss asking me to come to his office when I have a moment.
“Heck!” I whisper. I stand up abruptly, grab my phone, and throw it into my pocket, rushing down the hall to Anderson’s office. God, this is going to look really weird, isn’t it?
I knock on the door and straighten myself out, but in my head, I know I’m going to look like a mess.
“Come in,” I hear Anderson call, and I slowly open the door.
“Hi,” I say shyly, moving forward into the room.
“Ah, Esme,” he smiles. He gestures at me. “Come in, close the door behind you.”
Oh God, am I being fired?
“I’m sorry, sir, I didn’t see your messages until just now. I was busy with my work.”
He nods but tells me to sit down. “No problem, I just wanted to discuss something with you.”
The moment my body touches the soft cushion of the chair, I’m quick to explain. “I completely forgot that I’d asked for time off, and then I didn’t even remember until I read your messages! I’m so sorry for—”
He holds up a hand to stop me, and I listen, confused. “That’s not why I called you in here.”
“Oh,” I say, shrinking into the chair. If I could just disappear into thin air right now, that’d be wonderful.
“I did, however, want to ask you if you’re alright. You do seem a bit…tense.”
I need the power of invisibility right about now.
“Yes,” I lie.
“And the conversations around the office about you looking for rental options?”
Heck, I’ve been caught.
“Are you looking for a place, Esme?” He asks again.
He must have listened in on one of those conversations because I only spoke to a few people, and they were relatively short ones.
“I’m sorry, really, I hope you can understand that this has been a difficult time for me. I’m sorry for discussing personal matters during work hours.”
He raises his hands to me to calm me.
“Esme, take a breath. It’s fine; we have a comprehensive employee care system.” Anderson gives me a deep look, seemingly looking for something. “Considering your…special situation, the company has some housing allowances for employees.”
I sit up straighter. “Really?”
The man nods. “Yes.”
I let a long sigh out. “Oh, wow, okay, thank you, sir. And thank you for not telling anyone about the divorce. I haven’t told anyone, and I’m not exactly ready for the entire thing to go public.”
He nods again. “That’s tough, and I understand.”
I feel compelled to apologize again; this information on the housing is incredibly helpful, and I’m so sleep-deprived that it actually seems like a good idea to shake his hand and give him a hug.
Get your things together, Esme.
His small smile and that nod, however, make me feel a special spark ripple through me. Finally, someone understands and has given me the best encouragement I’ve received yet.
I’m so grateful for his kindness, but a few tears prickle the corners of my eyes. Something about his stature and genuine concern for my well-being and home life makes me feel closer to Anderson than to my own friends.
“I appreciate the information and for everything you’ve done for me, sir.”
“My best employee deserves to know that she is a valuable member to the team. If you’re not in top fighting shape, then we all lose, correct?”
I nod vigorously. “Of course, yes.”
“Very well. Go speak to Mrs. Halloway on the third floor about your housing request, and she should be able to get everything sorted out for you today. Hurry, though, she’ll be leaving any minute.”
I jump up, and without really thinking, I get moving, calling over my shoulder my appreciation once more.
As I rush down the stairs, I remind myself that Anderson is also divorced. He’s even got two little girls to take care of. Maybe, this is a shared sympathy?
He must know the torture I’ve been enduring since Ryan’s heinous words last night. A divorce is a painful process.
I believe, however, that my situation is guaranteed worse than anyone will know.
I manage to catch Mrs. Halloway as she’s putting her papers together to leave. She is kind enough to sit with me for twenty minutes after five as we sign papers, and I’m given the keys to a new apartment to live in.
I call Annie and Lily in hopes the two women can help me move out tonight. The sooner I’m out of this place, the better.
As we’re putting my things into boxes as quickly as possible, the girls prod me with a bunch of questions.
Clearly, everything is moving quickly to them.
“You said this is company-provided housing?” Annie asks, incredulous.

Chapter 5
I smile, pushing some curly blonde hair behind my ear and out of my eyes. “Yeah, it is.”
“How much is your rent going to cost?” Lily jumps in.
I think for a second, putting books into another box. “Uh, about two thousand.”
Lily throws a pillow at me, pursing her red lips in my direction as she waves her arms around in the air. “I’m going to murder you!”
“What?” I laugh, unsure what she’s talking about.
“I never envied your promotion; everyone knows how hard you work. If I worked late like you, my face would collapse!”
Annie says, “But this, I cannot forgive you for!”
“Why?” I question, hands on my waist.
The two girls look at one another before returning their gazes to me.
“Oh, I don’t know,” Annie replies, rolling her eyes.
“City center,” Lily ticks on her finger.
“One thousand square meters,” Annie says next.
“Fully furnished apartment.”
“Swimming pool, security, a gym downstairs.”
“Only 100 meters from the closest shopping center!”
“And we’re going to kick you out after you’ve signed the contract.” Lily crosses her arms with a satisfying smirk on her face.
I roll my eyes and sigh but understand they’re having fun at my expense. “Girls, this is the employee care system, okay? I’m getting a divorce.”
I point at Lily. “And you? With one handsome boyfriend after another.” Then, I point at the tall blonde. “And you, with a husband that absolutely adores you! Life is fair for the two of you, and there’s no need to be jealous of my pathetic life.”
I let myself fall to the ground with my legs crossed, exhausted.
Annie approaches me, her hand on my shoulder. “We know, hon,” she reassures me.
“And we’re sorry you’re going through all of this right now,” Lily adds, joining us on the floor.
“We’re just trying to keep you as happy as we can,” the first woman insists. “You’re our best friend, Esme, and we just want you to smile.”
I take both girls around the shoulders and hold them close, so thankful to have the two greatest friends on the planet.
“What the heck would I do without you two?”
Lily shrugs against my embrace. “You’d probably be packing this place by yourself?”
Annie nods matter-of-factly. “Also, no one would be here to taunt you.”
“Or remind you that Ryan’s a loser, and you’re a thousand times better off without him!”
“Plus, then you’d have no one to invite to your new, beautiful, stunning apartment!” Annie finishes, clapping her hands together as I let them both go.
“You two are absolutely ridiculous!” I roll my eyes.
“But you love us!” They sing song together.
It takes only a few hours of rushed packing to get out of the house I’ve lived in for the past several years. I look around one more time once the girls have left, saying goodbye to pieces of my home that will no longer be mine.
The perfect window perch to look out at the view around me.
The spot on the wooded living room floor where I’d spilled just a touch of black nail polish.
The perfect shower and bath combo that I used to lie in for hours at a time enjoying the calm.
The walk-in closet is mostly barren now.
The steps that I’d tripped down the first time I got a promotion.
“It’s not easy to say goodbye,” I whisper to the house. The creaks and the shadows that I’ve grown so used to will just become a faded memory. “I’ll miss you.”
A creak in the ceiling sounds as if the home is replying to my final words.
“Thank you for these past few years,” I finish, standing in the middle of the living room and taking one final deep breath in.
Then, I take off my wedding ring and place it on the kitchen table next to my house key. This is it. This is the end of my story here.
I grab my car keys off the counter by the front door, take one more look around, and then I finally make my exit, knowing there’s no chance I’ll ever walk through this door again.
I’m no longer Esme, Ryan’s wife.
Now I’m Esme, a strong, independent woman who is relearning the world around her.
“You took your sweet time,” Lily taunts as I finally get into my car downstairs.
“Just needed to say goodbye,” I insist.
“Only you would say goodbye to a freaking house,” Annie says, poking my arm from the passenger seat. Her nails are white today, and I swat her hand away.
“Let’s gooo, come on!” Lily cries, holding out the second word to annoy us. She jumps up and down in the backseat. “Onward to new adventures, Esme!”
The drive to the new apartment isn’t too far. It’s about ten minutes away from the house, and surprisingly, it’s pretty close to our favorite dive, Ransom’s Tavern. That’s pretty perfect since it’s the middle point for all three of us.
“Wow,” Annie whispers as she looks out the window on her side of the car. “Look how beautiful.”
“When you said the city center, you really meant it,” I reply to the two, leaning forward in my car to see the apartment building as it towers over us.
“The name fits well, too,” Lily adds, pointing out the window ahead of us. I follow her gaze as I see the plaque.
“Center City Apartments.”
“This is nuts,” I say without really thinking about it.
“You’re telling us,” Lily huffs. “Heck, Esme.”
We get a parking spot to the elevators closest to where my unit is supposed to be, and the girls and I start planning our attack.
“So, let’s get the important stuff into the bedroom first, and then we’ll grab everything else and put it in the living room,” I instruct.
“Good plan,” Annie nods, pulling her straight, blonde hair into a ponytail.
We spend about an hour just bringing things up to the apartment, moving quickly and laughing with one another about how dumb we all look doing this.
“Hire movers next time!” Lily grunts as she drops a box of clothes on the ground. “If I’d known this was how I was spending tonight, I’d have told you I was busy!”
Annie bumps our friend as she walks by with another box of pictures and memorabilia. “At least if she hired movers, they’d probably be hot!”
Lily gasps. “Oh God, yes! They’d probably be all hot and sweaty and look amazing. Instead, I stink, and I’m tired and hungry!”
I throw the closest object at Lily, which just so happens to be my car keys. “You love me, and you’d never leave me in the lurch.”
Annie and Lily both shrug at the same time, and the three of us head back to the car for the final round of transferring my stuff.
Once we’re done, the two girls decide to utilize the fully furnished couches, but I end up kicking them out so they can each go home and spend time with their men.
“Call us later if you need some talk therapy?” Annie asks.
I give her a hug. “Of course.”
“Don’t call me, I’ll be sleeping for the next four days,” Lily deadpans, so I shove her playfully before giving her a hug and watching the two head off together.
I look around the apartment, not sure where to start. Maybe the best step is to be neighborly and go greet the people who live next store.
I head out of the door and go to put my new key in my side pocket. However, I accidentally drop the metal onto the ground and crouch down to pick it up.
Suddenly, as I’m picking up the key, a little missile comes barreling toward me, and the blur crashes into my arms before falling to the ground.
Instincts take over, and I quickly pick up the small child, an adorable little girl with dark hair. Instantly, she begins to cry as I hold her close and stand back up.
“No, it’s okay!” I tell her, bouncing her. “Don’t cry!”
I look around for an adult, but I’m only met with another girl, a few years older than the first, who looks like a carbon copy. However, she is glaring at me.
“How dare you make my sister cry!” She shouts out. “I’m telling my dad on you!”
Then, as the older girl is yelling, a man in a bathrobe comes running out of the apartment next door, calling out his apologies for his daughter scaring me.
The first thing I see is a set of perfect abs, and I have a hard time pulling away from the sight. Wow, what a handsome set of abs.
My eyes move up from the abs to the eyes of the tall, tanned man. He looks incredibly relaxed and handsome as he stands in front of me, but it takes me about five seconds longer than it should to put it together.
I can’t help but gulp as I set down the girl in my arms.
My boss…he’s my neighbor?!

Looking in the mirror finally, I svcked in a breath; my slim figure was encased in an icy blue crot-chless cami suspender set.
"Seriously, it's like wearing a piece of dental floss!" I shouted.
"No pain, no gain, Lottie! Go, show Mike!"she grinned knowingly.
With a final look in the mirror, I admitted she was right. It did look good on me.
Mike and I had not had much alone time lately; he was always working, Alpha Leigh had been keeping him busy lately.
Getting to the apartment I shared with Mike didn't take long. Seizing my keys from my bag, I froze, hearing the muffled sound of talking from behind our apartment door. Mike was home!
Is he watching por-n? I laughed, hearing the barely moans from within the apartment walls.
"Mike! Don't stop! OMG, harder!" A female panted came out.
What? I quietly walked into the apartment; the closer I got, the more I understood.
"As you wish, baby girl!" MY boyfriend moaned.
"The fck you are!" I roared, opening the door with a bang.
"Shiit!" Mike’s panicked voice spluttered as I broke in.
"I didn't think you would be back till later?" Mike dared to say, looking at me like I had done something wrong.
I mutter, walking over to the closet, grabbing my luggage and shoving things into it.
"Lottie, come on." Mike got from the bed. "Work has been tough lately, and..." Before he finished the sentence, I punch him in the face.
"We are done." I declare my mind made up.
******
"Another?" I requested, tapping my empty glass.
“You’ve had enough” Lily stopped me.
"I just caught my boyfriend shagging someone else; I think another drink is needed!"
"Lottie, you need to sleep." Lily was trying to be serious, pulling me up from chair. "Come on, let's go home."
Twenty minutes later, we pulled up at the pack house.
"I will grab water; you go on up!" Lily said.
I nodded and headed to the bathroom.I just wished to wash all memories of today. Svcking in a breath, I froze, the sound of running water hitting my ears.
Pushing the door open, I froze; through the glass panel of the shower, Lilly's brother stood, hand pressed up against the wall, his body ripped with even more muscles then he left with.
"Either join me or get out!" He rasped as the second our eyes met.
